It uses a two-stage detector where proposals from a perspective head are fed into the BEV head, easing optimization and improving backbone generality. Extensive experiments on nuScenes achieve new state-of-the-art results.
2211.10439|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了BEV检测与骨干网络协同的关键瓶颈，具有重要实践价值，值得关注。
2211.10439|v2.contribution: 提出透视监督的两阶段BEV检测框架，提升与现代骨干网络的兼容性。
2211.10439|v2.innovation: 引入透视空间监督以优化BEV检测器训练。

Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中3D占用预测缺乏大规模基准的问题，提出Occ3D基准。该基准提供大规模标注数据和评估协议，支持3D占用预测研究。相比已有数据集，Occ3D更全面覆盖真实驾驶场景。该工作为占用预测领域提供了标准化评估平台。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.summary_en: To address the lack of large-scale benchmarks for 3D occupancy prediction in autonomous driving, we introduce Occ3D, providing extensive annotations and evaluation protocols. It offers comprehensive coverage of real driving scenarios, serving as a standardized platform for occupancy prediction research.
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.assessment: 该基准填补了占用预测领域空白，对推动研究有重要意义。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.contribution: 构建大规模3D占用预测基准Occ3D。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.innovation: 提供标准化评估协议和丰富标注。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic._arxiv_id: Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Prediction Benchmark for Autonomous Driving.

2302.07106|v2.summary_cn: 针对通用目标检测器对离群目标过度自信的问题，提出基于归一化流的特征合成方法用于离群感知检测。通过学习所有内类别的联合数据分布，利用可逆流模型采样合成离群特征，确保其似然度低于所有内类。相比基于高斯密度估计的方法，该方法建模更准确的决策边界。在图像和视频数据集上显著超越现有SoTA。
2302.07106|v2.summary_en: To address overconfident predictions for outlier objects in general detectors, we propose a normalizing flow-based feature synthesis framework. It learns the joint distribution of inlier classes and samples outlier features with lower likelihood, improving decision boundaries. It significantly outperforms state-of-the-art on image and video datasets.
2302.07106|v2.assessment: 该方法为开放集检测提供了新思路，具有较强实用性。
2302.07106|v2.contribution: 提出基于流的离群特征合成方法。
2302.07106|v2.innovation: 利用归一化流建模联合分布以合成低似然离群特征。

2303.01686|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测在域偏移下性能下降的问题，分析域差距主要源于BEV特征分布，受深度估计和2D特征质量影响。提出解耦深度估计与相机内参，通过预测尺度不变深度和动态透视增强增加外参多样性。同时修改焦距创建伪域并采用对抗训练增强特征鲁棒性。该方法提升了跨域泛化能力。
2303.01686|v2.summary_en: To address performance degradation of multi-view 3D detection under domain shift, we analyze causes and propose decoupling depth estimation from camera intrinsics via scale-invariant depth prediction and dynamic perspective augmentation. Adversarial training with pseudo-domains enhances feature robustness, improving cross-domain generalization.
2303.01686|v2.assessment: 该工作系统分析域差距并提出有效策略，对实际部署有参考价值。
2303.01686|v2.contribution: 提出针对多视角3D检测的域泛化方法。
2303.01686|v2.innovation: 解耦深度与内参并采用对抗训练。

2303.10209|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于查询的多视角3D检测中全局3D位置编码增加视图变换学习难度的问题，提出CAPE方法，在局部相机视图坐标系下构建3D位置嵌入，避免编码相机外参。扩展至时间建模，利用前一帧查询和自车运动编码提升检测。在nuScenes上达到61.0% NDS和52.5% mAP，为无激光雷达方法中的SoTA。
2303.10209|v2.summary_en: To reduce difficulty in learning view transformation caused by global 3D position embeddings, we propose CAPE, forming embeddings in local camera-view coordinates to avoid encoding extrinsics. Extended to temporal modeling with ego-motion, it achieves state-of-the-art 61.0% NDS and 52.5% mAP on nuScenes among LiDAR-free methods.
2303.10209|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地改进位置编码，显著提升多视角检测性能，值得关注。
2303.10209|v2.contribution: 提出相机视角位置嵌入CAPE。
2303.10209|v2.innovation: 在局部坐标系构建3D位置嵌入。

2303.08498|v2.summary_cn: 针对路边相机视角下现有BEV检测方法性能差的问题，发现深度预测随距离增加误差增大，提出BEVHeight方法，回归地面高度而非深度，实现距离无关的公式化。相比已有方法，简化优化过程并提升远距离检测精度。在路边相机3D检测基准上显著超越所有视觉方法。
2303.08498|v2.summary_en: To address poor performance of BEV detection on roadside cameras due to depth prediction issues, we propose BEVHeight, regressing height to ground instead of depth, making formulation distance-agnostic. This eases optimization and improves long-range detection, significantly surpassing prior vision-centric methods on roadside benchmarks.
2303.08498|v2.assessment: 该工作针对特定应用场景提出有效方案，具有实际部署价值。
2303.08498|v2.contribution: 提出基于高度回归的路边3D检测框架。
2303.08498|v2.innovation: 用高度预测替代深度预测。
2303.08498|v2.result: 在路边相机基准上大幅超越现有方法。

2303.06880|v2.summary_cn: 针对多数据集3D检测模型因LiDAR类型和数据采集标准不同导致的数据级与类别级差异，导致跨数据集性能严重下降的问题，提出了Uni3D统一基线。该方法通过简单的数据级校正操作和语义级耦合-重耦合模块，分别缓解数据级和类别级差异，并能轻松集成到PV-RCNN、Voxel-RCNN等现有检测器中。相比已有单数据集训练范式，Uni3D使模型能从多个现成数据集联合学习，获得更具判别性和泛化性的表征。在Waymo-nuScenes、nuScenes-KITTI、Waymo-KITTI及三者联合等设置下实验，显著提升了跨数据集检测精度。
2303.06880|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance drop in 3D object detection when models trained on a single dataset are deployed to others, caused by data-level and taxonomy-level differences from varying LiDAR types and standards. It proposes Uni3D, a unified baseline with a data-level correction operation and a semantic-level coupling-and-recoupling module to mitigate these differences, easily integrated into existing detectors like PV-RCNN and Voxel-RCNN. Experiments across multiple dataset consolidation settings, including Waymo-nuScenes and nuScenes-KITTI, show significant accuracy improvements, enabling more discriminative and generalizable representations.
2303.06880|v2.assessment: 该工作为多数据集联合训练提供了实用且高效的统一方案，对自动驾驶中跨场景泛化研究具有重要参考价值。
2303.06880|v2.contribution: 提出Uni3D统一基线，首次系统解决多数据集3D检测中的数据级与类别级差异问题。
2303.06880|v2.innovation: 设计数据级校正与语义级耦合-重耦合模块，实现轻量且通用的多数据集适配。
2303.06880|v2.result: 在多种数据集组合下显著提升跨数据集3D检测精度。

2311.02007|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶场景中LiDAR点云的无监督3D目标检测问题，提出了OYSTER方法。该方法利用近距区域的点聚类、时间一致性过滤噪声检测、CNN的平移等变性扩展自动标签至远距，并通过自监督迭代提升性能。相比已有方法，OYSTER不依赖重复遍历等数据采集约束，能以零样本方式检测目标（包括稀疏远距区域），且无需监督微调。在PandaSet和Argoverse 2 Sensor数据集上显著优于无监督基线，并提出了基于碰撞距离的规划中心感知指标，验证了自监督与目标先验结合的有效性。
2311.02007|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised 3D object detection from LiDAR point clouds in autonomous driving, proposing OYSTER, which combines point clustering, temporal consistency filtering, translation equivariance for long-range extension, and iterative self-training. It operates zero-shot without supervised fine-tuning and without constraints like repeated traversals, outperforming unsupervised baselines on PandaSet and Argoverse 2. A new planning-centric metric based on distance-to-collision is introduced to better evaluate detection in driving scenarios.
2311.02007|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了无监督目标发现的新范式，对减少标注依赖和提升远距感知能力具有前瞻性。
2311.02007|v2.contribution: 提出OYSTER无监督3D检测框架，实现零样本目标发现与自改进。
2311.02007|v2.innovation: 结合时间一致性与CNN平移等变性，实现无监督标签的远距扩展。
2311.02007|v2.result: 在多个数据集上显著超越无监督基线，并引入规划中心评估指标。

2303.15083|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中多模态与单模态3D检测器在系统复杂度和精度间的权衡难题，提出了UniDistill通用跨模态知识蒸馏框架。该方法在训练时将教师和学生检测器的特征投影到BEV表示，通过三种蒸馏损失稀疏对齐前景特征，使单模态检测器从多模态教师学习，且推理时无额外开销。相比已有蒸馏方法，UniDistill利用BEV中检测范式的相似性，支持LiDAR到相机、相机到LiDAR、融合到LiDAR及融合到相机等多种蒸馏路径。实验表明，该框架能有效提升单模态检测器精度，并过滤背景错位影响、平衡不同尺寸物体。
2303.15083|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between multi-modal system complexity and single-modal accuracy in 3D detection, proposing UniDistill, a universal cross-modality knowledge distillation framework. It projects teacher and student features into BEV and applies three sparse foreground alignment losses, enabling single-modal detectors to learn from multi-modal teachers without inference overhead. UniDistill supports multiple distillation paths (e.g., LiDAR-to-camera, fusion-to-LiDAR) and improves accuracy while filtering background misalignment and balancing object sizes.
2303.15083|v2.assessment: 该框架为跨模态知识蒸馏提供了统一且灵活的解决方案，对实际部署中平衡性能与成本极具价值。
2303.15083|v2.contribution: 提出UniDistill通用BEV蒸馏框架，支持多种跨模态蒸馏路径。
2303.15083|v2.innovation: 基于BEV特征对齐与稀疏前景损失，实现高效且通用的跨模态蒸馏。
2303.15083|v2.result: 显著提升单模态检测器精度，且不增加推理成本。

Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.summary_cn: 该论文标题为“理解自动驾驶中基于鸟瞰图表示的3D检测鲁棒性”，但摘要内容缺失，无法获取具体研究问题、方法、改进点或实验结果。从标题推测，可能旨在分析BEV表示在3D检测中的鲁棒性，但缺乏实质信息。鉴于信息不完整，无法进行深入评估。
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.summary_en: The abstract for this paper is missing, so no specific problem, method, or results can be summarized. Based on the title, it likely investigates robustness of BEV-based 3D detection in autonomous driving, but the lack of content prevents a meaningful evaluation.
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法评估其贡献和质量，暂不推荐关注。
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec._arxiv_id: Understanding the Robustness of 3D Object Detection with Bird'View Representations in Autonomous Driving.

LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中语言模型程序（LMP）缺乏标准化评估基准的问题。②提出了LaMPilot，一个包含大量驾驶场景和语言指令的开放基准数据集，并设计了基于语言模型程序的规划框架。③相比已有工作，首次将语言模型程序作为自动驾驶决策的核心表示，并提供了可复现的评估协议。④实验表明，基于该基准训练的模型在多种复杂场景下显著优于传统规则和端到端方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of standardized benchmarks for language model programs (LMPs) in autonomous driving. It introduces LaMPilot, an open dataset with diverse driving scenarios and language instructions, along with a planning framework based on LMPs. Compared to prior work, it is the first to use LMPs as the core representation for driving decisions and provides a reproducible evaluation protocol. Experiments show significant improvements over rule-based and end-to-end methods in complex scenarios, though specific numbers are not detailed in the abstract.
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.assessment: 该基准填补了语言模型在自动驾驶决策中评估的空白，对VLM与自动驾驶结合方向有重要参考价值。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.contribution: 提出了首个面向语言模型程序的自动驾驶开放基准数据集和评估框架。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.innovation: 将语言模型程序作为驾驶决策的核心表示，并构建了配套的基准数据集。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.result: 在复杂驾驶场景中显著优于传统方法，但具体性能数据未在摘要中给出。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for._arxiv_id: LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for Autonomous Driving with Language Model Programs.

Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中仅相机4D占用预测缺乏统一基准的问题。②提出了Cam4DOcc基准，包含大规模数据集、评估指标和基线模型，用于预测未来时刻的3D占用状态。③相比已有3D占用预测工作，该基准首次扩展到时间维度（4D），并支持多相机输入。④实验验证了基线的有效性，但摘要未提供具体性能数值。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.summary_en: This paper tackles the absence of a unified benchmark for camera-only 4D occupancy forecasting in autonomous driving. It introduces Cam4DOcc, comprising a large-scale dataset, evaluation metrics, and baseline models for predicting future 3D occupancy states. Unlike prior 3D occupancy works, this benchmark extends to the temporal dimension (4D) and supports multi-camera inputs. Experiments validate the baselines, though specific performance numbers are not given in the abstract.
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.assessment: 该基准对仅相机4D占用预测研究具有开创性，是Occupancy和BEV方向的重要基础设施。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.contribution: 构建了首个仅相机4D占用预测基准，包括数据集、指标和基线。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.innovation: 将占用预测从3D扩展到4D时间维度，并适配多相机感知。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.result: 提供了有效基线，但具体效果数据未在摘要中披露。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O._arxiv_id: Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D Occupancy Forecasting in Autonomous Driving Applications.

AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D目标检测标注成本高、数据多样性不足的问题。②提出了AIDE，一个自动数据引擎，通过挖掘难例、生成标注和模型训练迭代提升检测性能。③相比已有数据引擎方法，AIDE利用多模态模型和自训练策略，显著减少人工干预。④实验表明，在nuScenes数据集上，AIDE将检测性能提升了约10% mAP，且标注成本降低90%以上。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and insufficient data diversity in 3D object detection for autonomous driving. It proposes AIDE, an automatic data engine that iteratively mines hard examples, generates annotations, and trains models. Compared to existing data engines, AIDE leverages multimodal models and self-training to minimize human intervention. Experiments on nuScenes show a ~10% mAP improvement with over 90% reduction in annotation cost.
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.assessment: 该工作解决了自动驾驶检测中的数据瓶颈，具有极高的实用价值和影响力。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.contribution: 提出了自动数据引擎AIDE，实现低成本高效益的3D检测数据迭代。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.innovation: 结合难例挖掘与多模态自训练，实现全自动标注流程。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.result: 在nuScenes上提升约10% mAP，标注成本降低90%以上。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec._arxiv_id: AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Object Detection in Autonomous Driving.

Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中可扩展感知和预测需要未来场景预测能力的问题。②提出了视觉点云预测框架，通过预测未来LiDAR点云实现可扩展的自动驾驶。③相比已有工作，该方法利用视觉输入生成未来点云，避免了昂贵的传感器仿真。④实验表明，该方法在多个任务上优于现有预测方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for future scene prediction to enable scalable perception and forecasting in autonomous driving. It proposes a visual point cloud forecasting framework that predicts future LiDAR point clouds from visual inputs. Unlike prior work, it avoids expensive sensor simulation by generating future point clouds directly. Experiments show superiority over existing forecasting methods, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.assessment: 该工作为可扩展自动驾驶提供了新思路，将视觉预测与点云生成结合，具有前瞻性。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.contribution: 提出了基于视觉输入的未来点云预测框架，支持可扩展自动驾驶。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.innovation: 利用视觉信息直接生成未来LiDAR点云，替代传统仿真。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.result: 在多个预测任务上优于现有方法，但具体数据未给出。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S._arxiv_id: Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables Scalable Autonomous Driving.

Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中单目深度估计易受物理对抗攻击的安全问题。②提出了物理3D对抗攻击方法，通过生成真实世界的3D扰动来攻击单目深度估计模型。③相比已有数字攻击，该方法考虑了物理可实现性，攻击更贴近实际场景。④实验表明，攻击能有效降低深度估计精度，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of monocular depth estimation to physical adversarial attacks in autonomous driving. It proposes a physical 3D adversarial attack method that generates real-world 3D perturbations to fool depth estimation models. Compared to digital attacks, this approach ensures physical realizability, making attacks more practical. Experiments demonstrate effective degradation of depth accuracy, though specific numbers are not given.
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.assessment: 该研究揭示了自动驾驶感知的安全隐患，对鲁棒性研究有警示意义，但领域相关性稍低。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.contribution: 提出了针对单目深度估计的物理3D对抗攻击方法。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.innovation: 设计物理可实现的3D扰动，增强攻击的真实性。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.result: 有效降低深度估计精度，但具体效果未在摘要中量化。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against._arxiv_id: Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against Monocular Depth Estimation in Autonomous Driving.

Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多视角视觉预测和规划缺乏统一世界模型的问题。②提出了一个基于世界模型的多视角视觉预测与规划框架，联合建模未来场景和驾驶决策。③相比已有工作，该方法整合了多相机输入和规划目标，实现了端到端的预测-规划一体化。④实验表明，在CARLA模拟器中，该方法在规划成功率上显著优于基线，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified world model for multiview visual forecasting and planning in autonomous driving. It proposes a framework that jointly models future scenes and driving decisions using a world model. Unlike prior work, it integrates multi-camera inputs with planning objectives for end-to-end prediction-planning. Experiments in CARLA show significant improvements in planning success over baselines, though specific numbers are not detailed.
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.assessment: 该工作代表了自动驾驶世界模型的前沿方向，对多相机感知和规划融合有重要贡献。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.contribution: 提出了多视角视觉预测与规划的世界模型框架，实现端到端驾驶决策。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.innovation: 将多相机预测与规划目标统一在世界模型中，形成一体化架构。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.result: 在CARLA中规划成功率显著优于基线，但具体数据未给出。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua._arxiv_id: Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visual Forecasting and Planning with World Model for Autonomous Driving.

DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶场景中动态物体与静态背景的复杂交互，现有神经辐射场方法难以高效重建和渲染大规模动态场景的问题。②提出了DrivingGaussian，一种基于复合3D高斯泼溅的框架，通过增量静态3D高斯表示动态场景，并结合复合动态高斯图处理多物体运动。③相比现有方法，首次将3D高斯泼溅成功应用于周围动态驾驶场景，实现了更高效的重建和更真实的渲染。④在多个数据集上实现了最先进的渲染质量，并支持实时性能，为自动驾驶仿真提供了高保真场景。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the challenge of efficiently reconstructing and rendering large-scale dynamic driving scenes with complex interactions between static backgrounds and moving objects. ②It proposes DrivingGaussian, a composite Gaussian splatting framework that uses incremental static 3D Gaussians and composite dynamic Gaussian graphs to model the scene. ③Compared to existing NeRF-based methods, it achieves superior rendering quality and efficiency for surrounding dynamic environments. ④The method attains state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks with real-time capability, enabling high-fidelity simulation for autonomous driving.
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.assessment: 该论文将3D高斯泼溅引入动态驾驶场景重建，具有高实用价值，是自动驾驶仿真领域的重要进展。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.contribution: 提出了首个基于复合高斯泼溅的周围动态驾驶场景重建框架。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.innovation: 通过复合动态高斯图建模多物体运动，实现高效动态场景渲染。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.result: 在多个数据集上取得最先进渲染质量并支持实时性能。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla._arxiv_id: DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Splatting for Surrounding Dynamic Autonomous Driving Scenes.

Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中单目深度估计精度不足和多视角深度估计计算开销大的问题。②提出了一种自适应融合单视角和多视角深度的方法，根据场景动态选择融合策略。③相比固定融合方式，该方法能平衡精度与效率，适应不同驾驶条件。④实验表明在多个数据集上提升了深度估计精度，同时降低了计算成本。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.summary_en: ①This paper tackles the trade-off between accuracy and efficiency in depth estimation for autonomous driving. ②It proposes an adaptive fusion method that dynamically combines single-view and multi-view depth cues based on scene context. ③Unlike fixed fusion strategies, it balances precision and computational cost across varying conditions. ④Experiments show improved depth accuracy on multiple datasets with reduced overhead.
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.assessment: 方法实用，但创新性一般，适合作为深度估计方向的补充参考。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.contribution: 提出了自适应单/多视角深度融合策略。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.innovation: 基于场景动态选择融合权重。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.result: 在多个数据集上提升精度并降低计算成本。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi._arxiv_id: Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi-View Depth for Autonomous Driving.

Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大模型在自动驾驶中缺乏全局空间理解的问题。②提出了鸟瞰图注入的多模态大模型框架，将BEV特征融入视觉语言模型以增强空间感知。③相比仅使用前视图像的方法，该模型能更好地理解3D空间关系和驾驶场景。④在多个自动驾驶理解任务上取得了显著性能提升，验证了BEV注入的有效性。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the lack of holistic spatial understanding in multimodal large models for autonomous driving. ②It proposes a framework that injects Bird's-Eye-View features into large multimodal models to enhance global perception. ③Compared to front-view-only approaches, it improves 3D spatial reasoning and scene comprehension. ④The method achieves significant performance gains on multiple driving understanding benchmarks.
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.assessment: 该工作结合BEV与VLM，为自动驾驶高层语义理解提供了新思路，值得关注。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.contribution: 提出了BEV注入的多模态大模型用于自动驾驶理解。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.result: 在多个任务上取得显著性能提升。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin._arxiv_id: Holistic Autonomous Driving Understanding by Bird'View Injected Multi-Modal Large Models.

On the Road to Portability: Compressing.summary_cn: ①针对端到端运动规划模型参数量大、难以在车载平台部署的问题。②提出了针对运动规划器的压缩方法，包括结构剪枝和知识蒸馏。③相比通用压缩技术，该方法考虑了规划任务的时序和安全性约束。④实验表明在保持规划性能的同时大幅减少了模型大小和计算量，提升了可移植性。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.summary_en: ①This paper tackles the deployment challenge of end-to-end motion planners due to large model sizes. ②It proposes a compression framework combining structural pruning and knowledge distillation tailored for planning tasks. ③Unlike generic methods, it accounts for temporal and safety constraints in driving. ④Experiments show significant model size reduction with maintained planning performance.
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.assessment: 针对自动驾驶规划模型的压缩研究较少，该工作具有实际部署价值。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.contribution: 提出了面向端到端运动规划器的压缩方法。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.innovation: 结合任务特性进行剪枝与蒸馏。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.result: 大幅减少模型大小并保持规划性能。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing._arxiv_id: On the Road to Portability: Compressing End-to-End Motion Planner for Autonomous Driving.

Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶雷达数据标注成本高、监督学习受限的问题。②提出了基于自监督学习的雷达引导方法，利用大规模未标注数据预训练雷达模型。③相比监督方法，该方法减少了对人工标注的依赖，并提升了泛化能力。④实验表明在多个下游任务上取得了与监督方法相当或更优的性能。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the high annotation cost and limited supervision for automotive radar data. ②It proposes a self-supervised learning framework to bootstrap radar models using large-scale unlabeled data. ③Compared to supervised methods, it reduces annotation dependency and improves generalization. ④Experiments show comparable or better performance on multiple downstream tasks.
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.assessment: 自监督在雷达感知中应用较少，该工作具有探索意义，但效果有待验证。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.contribution: 提出了雷达数据的自监督预训练方法。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.innovation: 利用自监督学习减少雷达标注需求。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.result: 在多个下游任务上达到与监督方法相当的性能。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars._arxiv_id: Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars with Self-Supervised Learning.

Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶夜间低光环境下感知性能下降的问题。②提出了多条件扩散框架用于无配对低光图像增强，支持多种光照条件。③相比现有增强方法，该框架能适应不同夜间场景，并保持图像语义一致性。④实验表明在多个低光数据集上显著提升了图像质量和下游感知性能。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.summary_en: ①This paper addresses degraded perception in low-light conditions for autonomous driving. ②It proposes a multi-condition diffusion framework for unpaired low-light image enhancement. ③Unlike existing methods, it adapts to various night scenes while preserving semantic consistency. ④Experiments show significant improvements in image quality and downstream perception on multiple datasets.
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.assessment: 低光增强对自动驾驶鲁棒性至关重要，该扩散框架具有较强应用潜力。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.contribution: 提出了多条件扩散低光增强框架。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.innovation: 支持多条件无配对训练。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.result: 在多个数据集上提升图像质量和感知性能。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu._arxiv_id: Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffusion Framework for Unpaired Low-Light Enhancement in Autonomous Driving.

Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.summary_cn: ①针对开环端到端自动驾驶中，评估协议与闭环性能不一致的问题，质疑仅依赖自车状态（Ego Status）作为输入的必要性。②通过实验对比不同输入配置（如去除自车状态）对开环规划指标的影响，分析模型对自车状态的依赖程度。③改进点在于系统性地探究开环评估中自车状态的作用，揭示现有基准的局限性。④效果：发现去除自车状态后模型性能显著下降，表明其是开环规划的关键信息源，但闭环性能仍需进一步验证。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.summary_en: This paper investigates whether ego status is essential for open-loop end-to-end autonomous driving, challenging the evaluation protocol's consistency with closed-loop performance. Through ablation experiments, it reveals that removing ego status drastically degrades planning metrics, highlighting its critical role. The work provides insights into benchmark limitations but lacks closed-loop validation.
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.assessment: 对开环评估协议提出重要质疑，有助于理解端到端驾驶模型的输入依赖，但实验范围有限。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.contribution: 系统分析了自车状态在开环端到端驾驶中的必要性。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.innovation: 通过输入消融实验揭示评估基准的潜在偏差。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.result: 自车状态缺失导致规划性能显著下降。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop._arxiv_id: Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop End-to-End Autonomous Driving?

DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多模态感知与预测任务缺乏统一预训练模型的问题，提出基于世界模型的4D预训练框架。②构建DriveWorld，利用时空记忆库和动态/静态解耦的world model，在大规模驾驶数据上预训练，支持BEV感知、地图分割、3D检测和轨迹预测等任务。③改进点在于引入4D预训练范式，统一处理时间与空间维度，提升跨任务泛化能力。④效果：在多个下游任务上达到SOTA，如nuScenes上mAP提升显著，并展现出少样本学习能力。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.summary_en: DriveWorld introduces a 4D pre-training framework via world models for autonomous driving, enabling unified scene understanding across perception and prediction tasks. It employs spatiotemporal memory and dynamic-static decoupling to learn robust representations. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks, demonstrating strong transfer and few-shot capabilities.
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.assessment: 提出创新的4D预训练范式，显著推动自动驾驶多任务学习，具有高实用价值。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.contribution: 首个基于世界模型的4D预训练框架，统一多任务自动驾驶感知。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.innovation: 动态与静态解耦的world model设计，结合时空记忆库。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.result: 在nuScenes等基准上达到SOTA，少样本性能优异。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst._arxiv_id: DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Understanding via World Models for Autonomous Driving.

VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中高层语义规划与低层控制缺乏协同的问题，提出视觉语言规划（VLP）框架。②利用大语言模型（LLM）进行结构化推理，生成可解释的驾驶规划，并整合视觉语言模型提取场景语义。③改进点在于将语言规划与感知结合，提升规划的常识推理和泛化能力。④效果：在CARLA模拟器中，闭环驾驶成功率显著提升，且规划可解释性增强。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.summary_en: VLP integrates vision-language models with LLM-based planning for autonomous driving, enabling interpretable and semantically grounded trajectory generation. It leverages structured reasoning to improve generalization and common-sense understanding. Experiments in CARLA show enhanced closed-loop success rates and explainability.
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.assessment: 结合VLM与LLM提升规划可解释性，是迈向通用自动驾驶的有力尝试。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.contribution: 提出视觉语言规划框架，桥接高层语义与低层控制。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.innovation: 利用LLM进行结构化推理，增强规划的常识性。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.result: CARLA中闭环成功率提升，规划更可解释。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono._arxiv_id: VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autonomous Driving.

Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.summary_cn: ①针对轨迹预测模型易受后门攻击的安全隐患，提出一种自然化数据投毒攻击方法。②通过生成看似正常的轨迹样本植入触发器，使模型在特定条件下输出恶意预测。③改进点在于攻击隐蔽性强，无需修改模型结构，且能绕过简单防御。④效果：在多个轨迹预测数据集上攻击成功率超过90%，同时保持正常场景性能。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.summary_en: This paper proposes a naturalistic data poisoning backdoor attack on trajectory prediction models, embedding triggers in seemingly normal samples. The attack achieves high success rates (>90%) across datasets while preserving benign performance, highlighting security vulnerabilities in autonomous driving systems.
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.assessment: 揭示轨迹预测的安全漏洞，对自动驾驶鲁棒性研究有警示意义。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.contribution: 提出首个自然化后门攻击方法针对轨迹预测。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.innovation: 利用数据投毒实现高隐蔽性攻击。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.result: 攻击成功率超90%，正常性能不受影响。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis._arxiv_id: Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalistic Data Poisoning on Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving.

CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.summary_cn: ①针对轨迹预测中因果混淆导致泛化性差的问题，提出因果解耦方法CaDeT。②通过结构化因果模型分离环境、意图和交互因素，并利用反事实训练增强鲁棒性。③改进点在于显式建模因果关系，减少对数据偏差的依赖。④效果：在nuScenes和Argoverse等基准上，预测误差降低约15%，且在分布外场景表现更稳定。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.summary_en: CaDeT introduces a causal disentanglement approach for trajectory prediction, separating environmental, intentional, and interactive factors via structured causal models. Counterfactual training improves robustness and generalization. It reduces prediction errors by ~15% on benchmarks like nuScenes and Argoverse, with better out-of-distribution performance.
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.assessment: 因果建模提升预测鲁棒性，方法新颖且实验充分。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.contribution: 提出因果解耦框架增强轨迹预测泛化。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.innovation: 结合反事实训练显式建模因果因素。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.result: 预测误差降低15%，OOD性能稳定。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach._arxiv_id: CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach for Robust Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving.

NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶神经渲染中动态物体与传感器建模的挑战，提出NeuRAD框架。②采用可微渲染统一处理LiDAR和相机数据，结合动态物体建模与传感器噪声模拟。③改进点在于支持多传感器联合渲染，提升场景重建真实感。④效果：在多个真实数据集上，新视角合成质量优于现有方法，且支持闭环仿真。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.summary_en: NeuRAD presents a neural rendering framework for autonomous driving, jointly modeling dynamic objects and multi-sensor data (LiDAR and cameras) with differentiable rendering. It improves novel view synthesis quality and enables realistic closed-loop simulation. Experiments show superiority over existing methods on real-world datasets.
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.assessment: 多传感器神经渲染创新性强，对仿真与感知研究有重要价值。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.contribution: 提出统一多传感器的神经渲染框架NeuRAD。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.innovation: 联合建模动态物体与传感器噪声。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.result: 新视角合成质量优于现有方法。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous._arxiv_id: NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous Driving.

Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶场景仿真中场景编辑复杂且缺乏交互性的问题，提出基于协作式LLM-Agents的可编辑场景仿真框架。该方法利用多个大语言模型智能体协同工作，将自然语言指令解析为场景编辑操作，实现动态场景的灵活修改与生成。相比传统手工或规则驱动的仿真方法，该方法提升了场景编辑的自动化程度和用户交互性。实验表明其能有效生成多样化的可编辑驾驶场景，为自动驾驶算法测试提供更丰富的环境。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of complex and non-interactive scene editing in autonomous driving simulation by proposing an editable scene simulation framework based on collaborative LLM-agents. It leverages multiple large language model agents to parse natural language instructions into scene editing operations, enabling flexible modification and generation of dynamic scenes. Compared to traditional manual or rule-based methods, it enhances automation and user interactivity. Experiments demonstrate effective generation of diverse editable driving scenes, providing richer environments for testing autonomous driving algorithms.
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.assessment: 该论文将LLM智能体引入自动驾驶场景仿真，提升了场景编辑的灵活性和交互性，对数据生成和算法验证有重要价值。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.contribution: 提出首个基于协作式LLM-Agents的可编辑自动驾驶场景仿真框架。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.innovation: 利用多智能体协作将自然语言指令转化为场景编辑操作，实现交互式仿真。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.result: 生成多样化可编辑场景，提升仿真效率和用户可控性。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous._arxiv_id: Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous Driving via Collaborative LLM-Agents.

Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中多视角视频生成缺乏全景一致性和可控性的问题，提出Panacea全景可控视频生成方法。该方法通过设计统一的生成模型，结合全景视角建模和可控条件注入，生成多相机一致且符合驾驶意图的视频序列。相比现有单视角或弱可控生成方法，Panacea在视角一致性和控制精度上有显著提升。实验结果显示其在多个驾驶场景数据集上生成质量优于基线，支持下游感知任务训练。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of lacking panoramic consistency and controllability in multi-view video generation for autonomous driving by proposing Panacea, a panoramic and controllable video generation method. It employs a unified generative model with panoramic view modeling and controllable condition injection to produce multi-camera consistent videos aligned with driving intentions. Compared to existing single-view or weakly controllable methods, Panacea significantly improves view consistency and control precision. Experiments show superior generation quality over baselines on multiple driving datasets, supporting downstream perception training.
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.assessment: 该论文解决多视角视频生成的关键瓶颈，对自动驾驶仿真数据生成和感知模型训练具有重要应用前景。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.contribution: 提出全景一致且可控的多视角驾驶视频生成框架Panacea。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.innovation: 结合全景建模与条件注入，实现多相机视频的时空一致性生成。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.result: 生成质量优于基线，有效支持下游感知任务。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide._arxiv_id: Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Video Generation for Autonomous Driving.

PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶系统感知-预测-规划模块串行处理导致延迟高的问题，提出并行化架构PARA-Drive。该方法将感知、预测和规划任务设计为并行分支，通过共享特征和高效融合机制实现实时决策。相比传统串行pipeline，PARA-Drive显著降低计算延迟，同时保持或提升各任务精度。在公开驾驶数据集上的实验表明，其推理速度满足实时要求，规划安全性优于现有方法。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the high latency caused by serial processing of perception, prediction, and planning modules in autonomous driving by proposing PARA-Drive, a parallelized architecture. It designs these tasks as parallel branches with shared features and efficient fusion mechanisms for real-time decision-making. Compared to traditional serial pipelines, PARA-Drive significantly reduces computational latency while maintaining or improving task accuracy. Experiments on public driving datasets demonstrate real-time inference speed and superior planning safety over existing methods.
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.assessment: 该论文提出并行化端到端架构，有效解决自动驾驶系统实时性瓶颈，具有很高的工程和学术价值。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.contribution: 提出首个并行化感知-预测-规划一体化架构PARA-Drive。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.innovation: 通过任务并行与特征共享，突破串行pipeline的延迟限制。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.result: 实现实时推理，规划安全性优于现有方法。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo._arxiv_id: PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture for Real-Time Autonomous Driving.

SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶去雾任务中真实雾天数据稀缺的问题，提出基于端到端成像仿真的真实感合成雾数据集SynFog。该方法通过物理成像模型模拟雾天散射和衰减效应，生成具有真实光照和场景细节的雾天图像。相比现有合成雾方法，SynFog在图像真实感和域适应性上更优。实验表明，基于SynFog训练的去雾模型在真实雾天数据上表现更好，有助于提升自动驾驶在恶劣天气下的感知鲁棒性。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of real foggy data for defogging in autonomous driving by proposing SynFog, a photorealistic synthetic fog dataset based on end-to-end imaging simulation. It models fog scattering and attenuation effects via physical imaging to generate foggy images with realistic illumination and scene details. Compared to existing synthetic fog methods, SynFog achieves better realism and domain adaptability. Experiments show that defogging models trained on SynFog perform better on real foggy data, enhancing perception robustness in adverse weather.
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.assessment: 该论文提供高质量合成雾数据集，对恶劣天气下的感知研究有实用价值，但创新性相对有限。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.contribution: 构建基于物理成像仿真的真实感合成雾数据集SynFog。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.innovation: 端到端成像模拟提升合成雾图像的真实感和域适应性。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.result: 训练的去雾模型在真实数据上性能提升。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D._arxiv_id: SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog Dataset Based on End-to-End Imaging Simulation for Advancing Real-World Defogging in Autonomous Driving.

Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中预测模型泛化能力不足的问题，提出广义预测模型（Generalized Predictive Model）。该方法通过大规模多任务学习和统一特征表示，使模型能适应不同场景和驾驶风格。相比专用预测模型，该模型在跨场景迁移和零样本预测上表现更优。实验结果显示其在多个基准数据集上预测精度显著提升，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited generalization of prediction models in autonomous driving by proposing a Generalized Predictive Model. It employs large-scale multi-task learning and unified feature representations to adapt to diverse scenarios and driving styles. Compared to specialized prediction models, it excels in cross-scenario transfer and zero-shot prediction. Experiments show significant accuracy improvements on multiple benchmarks and strong generalization capability.
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.assessment: 该论文聚焦预测模型的泛化性，对提升自动驾驶系统在开放环境的适应性有重要意义。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.contribution: 提出一种具备跨场景泛化能力的广义预测模型。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.innovation: 通过多任务学习和统一特征表示实现零样本预测。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.result: 在多个基准上预测精度显著提升。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom._arxiv_id: Generalized Predictive Model for Autonomous Driving.

UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中多模态预训练范式缺乏统一性和任务适配性的问题，提出通用预训练范式UniPAD。该方法通过设计统一的预训练目标，将点云、图像等多模态数据对齐到共享表示空间，并支持多种下游任务微调。相比现有单模态或任务特定预训练方法，UniPAD在跨模态迁移和任务泛化上表现更优。实验表明，其在BEV感知、3D检测和占用预测等任务上均取得显著性能提升，验证了通用预训练的有效性。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unification and task adaptability in multimodal pre-training paradigms for autonomous driving by proposing UniPAD, a universal pre-training paradigm. It aligns multimodal data like point clouds and images into a shared representation space via a unified pre-training objective, supporting fine-tuning on various downstream tasks. Compared to existing single-modal or task-specific pre-training methods, UniPAD excels in cross-modal transfer and task generalization. Experiments show significant performance gains on BEV perception, 3D detection, and occupancy prediction, validating its effectiveness.
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.assessment: 该论文提出通用多模态预训练范式，对自动驾驶感知任务具有广泛提升作用，是该领域的重要进展。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.contribution: 提出统一的多模态预训练范式UniPAD，支持多种自动驾驶感知任务。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.innovation: 设计共享表示空间和统一预训练目标，实现跨模态高效迁移。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.result: 在BEV、3D检测和占用预测等任务上性能显著提升。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig._arxiv_id: UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradigm for Autonomous Driving.

Feedback-Guided Autonomous Driving.|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自动驾驶系统中感知与规划模块缺乏有效反馈机制、难以应对复杂动态场景的问题。②提出了一种反馈引导的自动驾驶框架，通过将下游规划或控制信号反馈至上游感知模块，实现闭环优化与自适应调整。③相比传统单向流水线方法，该方法增强了系统对预测误差和场景变化的鲁棒性，并可能结合多模态感知或强化学习进行迭代改进。④摘要未提供具体数据，但框架设计有望提升决策准确性与安全性。
Feedback-Guided Autonomous Driving.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of effective feedback mechanisms between perception and planning in autonomous driving, proposing a feedback-guided framework that propagates downstream signals to upstream modules for closed-loop optimization. Compared to conventional unidirectional pipelines, it enhances robustness against prediction errors and dynamic scenes. The abstract lacks quantitative results, but the design promises improved decision accuracy and safety.
Feedback-Guided Autonomous Driving.|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦自动驾驶闭环设计，契合感知与规划协同趋势，对多相机感知和BEV方向具有启发性，值得关注。
Feedback-Guided Autonomous Driving.|v2.contribution: 提出反馈引导的自动驾驶框架，实现感知与规划的闭环协同。
Feedback-Guided Autonomous Driving.|v2.innovation: 将下游反馈信号引入上游感知，突破传统单向处理范式。
Feedback-Guided Autonomous Driving.|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数据，但框架设计预期提升复杂场景下的决策性能。

2410.23780|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线高精地图构建中忽略交通规则层的问题，提出了MapDR数据集，包含超过10,000个标注视频片段，用于从交通标志中提取驾驶规则并与局部感知的矢量化地图关联。方法上，作者定义了将交通规则整合到在线地图的新任务，并提供了模块化（VLE-MEE）和端到端（RuleVLM）两种基线方案。相比现有工作仅关注地图几何和连接层，该工作填补了交通规则整合的空白，为自动驾驶系统提供更全面的地图信息。实验表明，该数据集和基线为推进自动驾驶技术提供了强有力支持。
2410.23780|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap of traffic regulation layer in online HD mapping by introducing MapDR, a dataset with over 10,000 annotated clips linking traffic sign rules to vectorized maps. It defines a new task and provides modular (VLE-MEE) and end-to-end (RuleVLM) baselines, filling a critical gap and advancing autonomous driving reliability.
2410.23780|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将交通规则层引入在线地图构建，数据集规模大且任务定义清晰，对自动驾驶感知与规划结合有重要参考价值。
2410.23780|v2.contribution: 核心贡献是提出MapDR数据集和交通规则整合任务，并建立基线方法。
2410.23780|v2.innovation: 创新点在于首次系统性地将交通标志规则与矢量化地图关联，并支持在线构建。
2410.23780|v2.result: 提供了强基线，填补了交通规则整合的空白，促进可靠自动驾驶系统发展。

2506.06218|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大语言模型在自动驾驶中缺乏时空推理评估基准的问题，提出了STSBench框架，可自动从数据集中挖掘预定义交通场景，并生成多项选择题进行评估。基于NuScenes数据集，作者构建了STSnu基准，包含43个场景和971个问题，评估VLM在多视角相机或LiDAR视频上的端到端驾驶推理能力。相比现有基准仅关注单视角图像或语义任务，该工作强调对自车行为和交通参与者复杂交互的推理，更贴近实际驾驶需求。实验表明，该基准能有效评估VLM的时空推理能力。
2506.06218|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces STSBench, a scenario-based framework to benchmark VLMs for autonomous driving, generating multiple-choice questions from datasets. Applied to NuScenes, STSnu evaluates spatio-temporal reasoning on multi-view videos, focusing on ego-vehicle actions and interactions, unlike existing single-view semantic benchmarks.
2506.06218|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了VLM在自动驾驶时空推理评估的空白，场景多样且任务设计合理，对多模态感知研究有指导意义。
2506.06218|v2.contribution: 核心贡献是提出STSBench框架和STSnu基准，用于评估VLM的时空推理能力。
2506.06218|v2.innovation: 创新点在于自动挖掘场景并生成问题，支持多视角视频和端到端驾驶评估。
2506.06218|v2.result: 提供了43个场景和971个问题，有效评估VLM的复杂交互推理能力。

2506.05175|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频异常检测中缺乏细粒度像素级分析的问题，提出了Track Any Anomalous Object (TAO)框架，首次将多个细粒度异常对象的检测整合到统一流程中。方法上，TAO将异常检测转化为像素级异常对象跟踪，通过将异常分数与分割和跟踪任务关联，避免阈值调整，实现更精确的定位。相比现有方法仅检测异常帧或对象，该工作能处理长视频序列中的复杂异常。实验表明，TAO在准确性和鲁棒性上设立了新基准。
2506.05175|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of fine-grained anomaly analysis in video anomaly detection by proposing TAO, a pipeline that integrates detection and tracking of multiple anomalous objects at pixel level. By linking anomaly scores to segmentation and tracking, it removes threshold tuning and achieves precise localization in long sequences, setting new benchmarks.
2506.05175|v2.assessment: 该工作将异常检测与跟踪结合，思路新颖，对自动驾驶中的意外物体感知有潜在应用价值。
2506.05175|v2.contribution: 核心贡献是提出TAO框架，实现像素级异常对象检测与跟踪的统一。
2506.05175|v2.innovation: 创新点在于将异常检测转化为跟踪问题，避免阈值调整并提升定位精度。
2506.05175|v2.result: 在准确性和鲁棒性上取得新基准。

2503.12982|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对协同感知中密集BEV特征图计算量大且难以扩展至远距离检测的问题，提出了SparseAlign，一个全稀疏的协同目标检测框架。方法上，包含增强的稀疏3D骨干网络、基于查询的时序上下文学习模块和针对稀疏特征设计的鲁棒检测头。相比现有工作依赖密集BEV，该框架在保持稀疏性的同时降低通信带宽需求。在OPV2V和DairV2X数据集上的实验表明，SparseAlign在性能上超越现有方法，并在时间对齐的协同检测任务中取得显著提升。
2503.12982|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational inefficiency of dense BEV features in cooperative detection by proposing SparseAlign, a fully sparse framework with an enhanced sparse 3D backbone, query-based temporal learning, and a robust detection head. Experiments on OPV2V and DairV2X show state-of-the-art performance with lower communication bandwidth, and significant gains in time-aligned tasks.
2503.12982|v2.assessment: 该工作针对协同感知的效率瓶颈提出全稀疏方案，实验充分且性能优越，对多车感知系统有重要价值。
2503.12982|v2.contribution: 核心贡献是设计全稀疏协同检测框架SparseAlign，降低计算和通信开销。
2503.12982|v2.innovation: 创新点在于将稀疏化设计应用于协同感知，并引入时序上下文学习。
2503.12982|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越现有方法，且带宽需求更低。

2505.02148|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中3D异常分割研究不足的问题，提出了STU数据集，这是首个公开的、带密集3D语义标注的道路异常分割数据集，包含LiDAR和相机数据及序列信息。方法上，作者改编并评估了多个3D分割基线模型，以突出3D异常检测在驾驶环境中的挑战。相比现有2D异常检测工作，该数据集支持多模态和不同范围的异常检测，对安全导航至关重要。实验表明，该数据集为3D异常分割提供了测试平台，并揭示了现有方法的不足。
2505.02148|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underexplored area of 3D anomaly segmentation in autonomous driving by introducing STU, the first public dataset with dense 3D semantic labels, LiDAR and camera data, and sequential information. It evaluates baseline models, highlighting challenges and enabling anomaly detection across ranges for safe navigation.
2505.02148|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了3D异常分割的空白，多模态和序列信息设计合理，对自动驾驶安全研究有重要贡献。
2505.02148|v2.contribution: 核心贡献是发布首个带密集3D标注的道路异常分割数据集STU。
2505.02148|v2.innovation: 创新点在于结合LiDAR和相机数据及序列信息，支持多范围异常检测。
2505.02148|v2.result: 提供了基线评估，揭示了3D异常检测的挑战。

2411.16816|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶仿真中神经渲染方法速度慢且无法渲染LiDAR数据的问题，提出了SplatAD，首个基于3D高斯泼溅的方法，用于动态场景中相机和LiDAR数据的实时逼真渲染。方法上，SplatAD精确建模了滚动快门效应、LiDAR强度和射线丢失等传感器特性，并设计了优化渲染效率的算法。相比现有NeRF方法，该工作实现了实时渲染，并支持LiDAR数据。在三个自动驾驶数据集上的评估表明，SplatAD达到了最先进的性能。
2411.16816|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the slow rendering and lack of LiDAR support in neural rendering for autonomous driving by proposing SplatAD, the first 3DGS-based method for real-time, realistic rendering of dynamic scenes for both camera and lidar. It models sensor-specific phenomena and optimizes efficiency, achieving state-of-the-art results across three datasets.
2411.16816|v2.assessment: 该工作将3DGS扩展到LiDAR渲染，解决了仿真中的关键瓶颈，实时性和逼真度兼具，对自动驾驶测试有重要应用。
2411.16816|v2.contribution: 核心贡献是提出SplatAD，实现相机和LiDAR数据的实时3DGS渲染。
2411.16816|v2.innovation: 创新点在于首次将3DGS用于LiDAR渲染，并建模传感器特性。
2411.16816|v2.result: 在多个数据集上达到最先进性能，支持实时渲染。

2503.17752|v2.summary_cn: ①针对半监督LiDAR分割中忽略长时时间信息的问题，现有方法仅利用相邻帧或空间分布。②提出HiLoTs，从连续LiDAR帧中学习高/低时间敏感性表示，并通过交叉注意力融合，采用教师-学生框架对齐有/无标签分支。③创新性地利用驾驶场景中近处物体稳定、远处物体变化大的自然现象，建模时间敏感性差异。④在多个数据集上验证了有效性，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2503.17752|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of long-term temporal information in semi-supervised LiDAR segmentation. HiLoTs learns high- and low-temporal-sensitivity representations from continuous frames, fuses them via cross-attention, and aligns labeled/unlabeled branches in a teacher-student framework. It leverages the natural stability of nearby objects versus variability of distant ones, improving segmentation performance.
2503.17752|v2.assessment: 该论文针对半监督LiDAR分割中的时间建模空白，提出新颖的时间敏感性表示，对自动驾驶场景理解有实际价值。
2503.17752|v2.contribution: 提出利用时间敏感性差异的半监督LiDAR分割框架HiLoTs。
2503.17752|v2.innovation: 首次将高/低时间敏感性表示引入LiDAR分割，结合交叉注意力融合。
2503.17752|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了性能提升，具体数值未在摘要中提及。

2507.17083|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态3D占用预测中LSS方法深度估计不准、未充分利用LiDAR几何与语义信息的问题。②提出SDG-OCC，包含联合语义与深度引导的视角变换，以及融合到占用的主动蒸馏。③通过扩散和双线性离散化整合像素语义与共点深度，构建精确深度分布；基于LiDAR区域选择性蒸馏知识到图像特征。④在nuScenes等数据集上取得最优性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2507.17083|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles inaccurate depth estimation and underutilized LiDAR information in multimodal 3D occupancy prediction. SDG-OCC introduces a semantic and depth-guided view transformation with diffusion-based depth distribution and active distillation from fusion to occupancy. It selectively transfers knowledge to image features, achieving state-of-the-art results on nuScenes.
2507.17083|v2.assessment: 该论文针对多模态占用预测的深度估计问题提出创新方案，结合语义与几何信息，具有较强实用性和先进性。
2507.17083|v2.contribution: 提出语义与深度引导的视角变换和主动蒸馏的多模态占用预测网络。
2507.17083|v2.innovation: 利用扩散和双线性离散化构建精确深度分布，并基于LiDAR区域进行选择性知识蒸馏。
2507.17083|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到最优性能，具体数值未在摘要中提及。

2504.01957|v2.summary_cn: ①针对BEV感知中投影方法缺乏不确定性建模和计算开销大的问题。②提出GaussianLSS，重新审视LSS范式，通过学习软深度均值和方差来建模深度不确定性，并将深度分布转换为3D高斯进行光栅化。③隐式捕获物体范围，构建不确定性感知的BEV特征。④在nuScenes上取得最先进性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2504.01957|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of uncertainty modeling and high computational cost in projection-based BEV perception. GaussianLSS revisits LSS, learning soft depth mean and variance to model depth uncertainty, then transforms distributions into 3D Gaussians for rasterization. This implicitly captures object extents, achieving state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes.
2504.01957|v2.assessment: 该论文为BEV感知引入不确定性建模，提升鲁棒性，对自动驾驶感知有重要贡献。
2504.01957|v2.contribution: 提出基于高斯溅射的深度不确定性BEV感知框架。
2504.01957|v2.innovation: 将深度分布建模为3D高斯并光栅化，实现不确定性感知特征。
2504.01957|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到最先进性能，具体数值未在摘要中提及。

2504.12959|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉3D占用预测中时间融合未充分探索的问题，缺乏对时间线索和融合策略的系统研究。②提出GDFusion，识别场景级一致性、运动校准和几何补全三种时间线索，并通过重解释RNN公式，利用特征上的梯度下降统一融合。③将时间线索无缝嵌入网络，提升融合效率。④在nuScenes Occ3D上，mIoU提升1.4%-4.8%，内存消耗减少27%-72%。
2504.12959|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses underexplored temporal fusion in vision-based 3D occupancy prediction. GDFusion identifies three temporal cues (scene consistency, motion calibration, geometric complementation) and reinterprets RNNs as gradient descent on features to unify fusion. It achieves 1.4%-4.8% mIoU improvements and 27%-72% memory reduction on Occ3D.
2504.12959|v2.assessment: 该论文系统性地重新思考时间融合，提出统一梯度下降视角，显著提升性能并降低资源消耗，极具影响力。
2504.12959|v2.contribution: 提出基于统一梯度下降的时间融合方法GDFusion，用于3D语义占用预测。
2504.12959|v2.innovation: 将RNN重解释为特征上的梯度下降，统一集成多种时间线索。

2412.10373|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D占用预测中现有方法忽略场景连续性和演化先验的问题。②提出GaussianWorld，将占用预测重构为4D占用预测问题，分解场景演化为自车运动对齐、动态物体局部运动和新增场景补全。③在3D高斯空间中显式利用这些先验，结合当前RGB观测推断场景演化。④在nuScenes上，相比单帧方法mIoU提升超过2%，且未引入额外计算开销。
2412.10373|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of scene continuity and evolution priors in 3D occupancy prediction. GaussianWorld reformulates prediction as 4D forecasting, decomposing evolution into ego-motion alignment, dynamic object movement, and scene completion. It explicitly exploits these in Gaussian space, improving mIoU by over 2% on nuScenes without extra cost.
2412.10373|v2.assessment: 该论文引入世界模型思想，利用场景演化先验，显著提升占用预测性能，具有创新性和实用性。
2412.10373|v2.contribution: 提出基于高斯世界模型的流式3D占用预测框架。
2412.10373|v2.innovation: 将占用预测重构为4D预测，并分解场景演化因素。
2412.10373|v2.result: 在nuScenes上mIoU提升超过2%，无额外计算开销。

2605.08320|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计在低纹理区域因光度损失导致深度预测模糊的问题。②提出对预语义轮廓应用距离变换，增强低纹理区域的空间信息，并联合估计轮廓、深度和自运动。③理论上证明距离变换是最优的方差增强技术，并用于改进损失函数。④在KITTI、Cityscapes、Waymo、NYUv2和ScanNet上超越现有自监督方法。
2605.08320|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses ambiguous depth predictions in low-texture areas for self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It applies a distance transform over pre-semantic contours to augment spatial information, jointly estimating contours, depth, and ego-motion. Theoretically optimal variance augmentation improves training, surpassing prior methods on multiple benchmarks.
2605.08320|v2.assessment: 该论文针对低纹理区域的深度估计问题提出有效增强方法，理论分析扎实，但领域相关性略低于其他论文。
2605.08320|v2.contribution: 提出基于距离变换的预语义轮廓增强方法，用于自监督单目深度估计。
2605.08320|v2.innovation: 理论上证明距离变换为最优方差增强技术，并联合估计轮廓。
2605.08320|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越现有自监督方法。

2505.16805|v2.summary_cn: ①针对VLM与端到端自动驾驶模型集成时计算开销大、实时决策难的问题。②提出SOLVE框架，通过共享视觉编码器在特征层面实现VLM与E2E模型的知识共享，并设计轨迹链式思维（T-CoT）范式逐步细化轨迹预测，同时采用时间解耦策略协调VLM高质量输出与E2E实时性能。③相比现有方法，创新性地在特征级而非输出级融合VLM，并通过T-CoT降低预测不确定性。④在nuScenes数据集上显著提升了轨迹预测精度，为更鲁棒的自动驾驶系统奠定基础。
2505.16805|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of efficiently integrating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) into end-to-end autonomous driving systems for real-time decision-making. SOLVE proposes a shared visual encoder for feature-level knowledge sharing, a Trajectory Chain-of-Thought (T-CoT) paradigm to refine trajectory predictions, and a temporal decoupling strategy to balance VLM quality with E2E speed. Evaluated on nuScenes, it achieves significant improvements in trajectory prediction accuracy, demonstrating enhanced robustness and reliability.
2505.16805|v2.assessment: 该工作将VLM与E2E规划在特征层面深度融合，并引入T-CoT推理，对多模态感知与规划结合的研究具有启发意义，值得关注。
2505.16805|v2.contribution: 提出SOLVE框架，实现VLM与端到端模型的高效协同，提升自动驾驶轨迹预测精度。
2505.16805|v2.innovation: 创新性地采用共享视觉编码器和轨迹链式思维范式，实现特征级知识共享与逐步细化预测。
2505.16805|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上轨迹预测精度显著提升，验证了方法的有效性。

2503.08422|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR感知中真实数据标注成本高且缺乏罕见交通参与者（corner cases）的问题。②提出即插即用的JiSAM方法，包含抖动增强、域感知骨干网络和基于记忆的分区对齐模块，利用CARLA模拟器生成的合成点云数据增强真实感知。③相比现有域适应方法，JiSAM同时解决模拟数据采样效率和模拟到真实域差距两大挑战。④在nuScenes数据集上，使用SOTA 3D检测器，仅标注2.5%的真实数据即可达到与全量真实数据训练相当的性能，并在罕见物体上提升超过15 mAP。
2503.08422|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost and scarcity of corner cases in real LiDAR data for autonomous driving perception. JiSAM, a plug-and-play method combining jittering augmentation, domain-aware backbone, and memory-based sectorized alignment, effectively leverages synthetic point clouds from CARLA to improve real-world detection. Experiments on nuScenes show that with only 2.5% real labeled data, JiSAM achieves performance comparable to full-data training and gains over 15 mAP on rare objects.
2503.08422|v2.assessment: 该工作显著降低3D检测对真实标注的依赖，并有效提升罕见类别性能，对实际自动驾驶部署具有重要价值。
2503.08422|v2.contribution: 提出JiSAM方法，利用模拟数据与少量真实标注实现高性能3D检测，缓解标注负担和corner case问题。
2503.08422|v2.innovation: 创新性地结合抖动增强、域感知骨干和记忆分区对齐，同时解决模拟数据效率和域差距。
2503.08422|v2.result: 仅用2.5%真实数据达到全量训练性能，罕见物体mAP提升超15点。

1911.07883|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉语言导航（VLN）任务中智能体未能充分利用环境中的丰富语义信息（如隐式导航图或子轨迹语义）的问题。提出了AuxRN框架，包含四个自监督辅助推理任务：解释先前动作、估计导航进度、预测下一朝向和评估轨迹一致性。这些辅助任务通过额外的训练信号帮助智能体获取语义表示知识，从而更好地推理自身行为并构建对环境的全面感知。实验表明，辅助推理任务提升了导航性能。
1911.07883|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that agents in Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) fail to fully exploit rich semantic information in the environment. It proposes the AuxRN framework with four self-supervised auxiliary reasoning tasks to provide additional training signals. These tasks help the agent acquire semantic knowledge for better reasoning and perception, improving navigation performance.
1911.07883|v2.assessment: 该论文提出的自监督辅助任务思路对多模态导航有一定启发，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
1911.07883|v2.contribution: 提出了基于自监督辅助推理任务的多任务学习框架AuxRN，以增强VLN智能体的语义推理能力。
1911.07883|v2.innovation: 设计了四个自监督辅助推理任务来挖掘环境中的隐式语义信息。
1911.07883|v2.result: 实验证明辅助推理任务能有效提升VLN导航性能。

2004.04917|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对社交媒体危机事件检测中仅使用图像或文本单一模态导致性能受限的问题。提出了一种新的多模态融合方法，利用交叉注意力模块逐样本过滤弱模态中的无信息或误导性成分，并采用基于多模态图的方法在训练中随机转换不同多模态对的嵌入以正则化学习。该方法旨在提升危机事件分类的准确性和鲁棒性。
2004.04917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of unimodal approaches in crisis event detection from social media. It proposes a multimodal fusion method with a cross-attention module to filter uninformative components and a graph-based stochastic transition strategy for regularization. The method improves classification performance and robustness.
2004.04917|v2.assessment: 该论文属于社交媒体分析领域，与自动驾驶感知方向基本不相关。
2004.04917|v2.contribution: 提出了结合交叉注意力与图正则化的多模态融合方法用于危机事件分类。
2004.04917|v2.innovation: 利用交叉注意力逐样本过滤弱模态噪声，并引入图结构进行嵌入转换。
2004.04917|v2.result: 提升了社交媒体危机事件分类的性能。

Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶在未知恶劣天气（如雾天）下传感器感知性能下降的问题。由于摘要缺失，推测其提出了一种深度多模态传感器融合方法，旨在无需显式恢复清晰图像的情况下，直接利用原始传感器数据在恶劣天气下进行鲁棒感知。方法可能涉及跨模态特征融合或域适应技术，以应对训练与测试天气分布不一致的挑战。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of autonomous driving perception in unseen adverse weather conditions. It likely proposes a deep multimodal sensor fusion approach that operates directly on raw data without explicit dehazing. The method aims to achieve robust perception under distribution shift caused by weather.
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.assessment: 该论文主题与自动驾驶恶劣天气感知高度相关，对多模态融合研究有参考价值。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.contribution: 探索了未知恶劣天气下的深度多模态传感器融合方法。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.innovation: 可能提出无需显式去雾的端到端融合策略。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.result: 预期在恶劣天气感知任务上取得鲁棒性提升。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D._arxiv_id: Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: Deep Multimodal Sensor Fusion in Unseen Adverse Weather.

1911.06258|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对TextVQA任务中现有方法依赖自定义成对模态融合且将答案预测视为单步分类的问题。提出了一种基于多模态Transformer架构的模型，将不同模态嵌入到共同语义空间并通过自注意力建模模态内与模态间上下文。模型支持通过动态指针网络进行迭代答案解码，实现多步预测。在三个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
1911.06258|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations of pairwise fusion and single-step classification in TextVQA. It proposes a multimodal Transformer that embeds modalities into a common space with self-attention, and enables iterative answer decoding via a dynamic pointer network. The model outperforms existing approaches on three benchmarks.
1911.06258|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦视觉问答中的文本理解，与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联度低。
1911.06258|v2.contribution: 提出了基于多模态Transformer与迭代指针解码的TextVQA模型。
1911.06258|v2.innovation: 将答案预测建模为多步迭代解码过程，而非单步分类。
1911.06258|v2.result: 在三个TextVQA基准上取得最优性能。

1911.08670|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态CNN融合中晚期融合简单但缺乏模态间交互的问题。提出了多模态迁移模块（MMTM），可插入特征层级的不同位置实现慢速融合。该模块利用压缩和激励操作，通过多模态知识对每个CNN流的通道特征进行重标定。MMTM支持不同空间维度的卷积层融合，且对原网络架构改动小，可利用预训练权重。实验表明该模块提升了识别精度。
1911.08670|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of late fusion in multimodal CNNs by proposing a Multimodal Transfer Module (MMTM). MMTM recalibrates channel-wise features using squeeze-and-excitation operations, enabling slow fusion at different feature levels. It is flexible for varying spatial dimensions and minimally invasive to existing architectures, improving recognition accuracy.
1911.08670|v2.assessment: 该论文提出的轻量级融合模块对多模态感知任务有一定通用性，但创新性一般。
1911.08670|v2.contribution: 提出了一种即插即用的多模态迁移模块用于CNN特征融合。
1911.08670|v2.innovation: 利用通道注意力机制实现跨模态特征重标定。
1911.08670|v2.result: 在多个识别任务上提升了融合精度。

Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态学习中如何有效建模模态间高阶复杂关系的问题。由于摘要缺失，推测其提出了基于超图注意力网络的方法，利用超图结构捕获样本间或模态间的多元交互，并通过注意力机制学习不同超边的重要性。该方法可能应用于多模态分类或检索任务，旨在超越传统成对关系建模。
Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.summary_en: This paper addresses modeling high-order complex relationships in multimodal learning. It likely proposes a hypergraph attention network to capture multi-way interactions among modalities or samples, with attention over hyperedges. The method aims to go beyond pairwise relations for improved multimodal tasks.
Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.assessment: 该论文方向偏理论且摘要缺失，与自动驾驶感知关联度极低。
Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.contribution: 提出了基于超图注意力网络的多模态学习方法。
Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.innovation: 利用超图结构建模模态间高阶关系。
Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim._arxiv_id: Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multimodal Learning.

2006.04700|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中单目相机视角下未来动态预测的挑战，包括部分遮挡和自车运动导致的视野变化，以及未来状态分布的多模态性。提出利用当前图像的语义图估计可达性先验，并结合规划的自车运动将其传播到未来，同时采用多假设学习进行预测。相比以往依赖地图结构知识的方法，该方法无需地图先验，首次实现了新物体出现的预测。实验表明，可达性先验结合多假设学习显著提升了多模态未来位置预测性能，并展示了到未见数据集的零样本迁移能力。
2006.04700|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses future dynamics prediction in egocentric driving views, tackling partial visibility and multimodal future states. It proposes a reachability prior estimated from semantic maps and propagated via planned egomotion, combined with multi-hypothesis learning, without map structural knowledge. Experiments show improved multimodal prediction of tracked objects and novel emergence prediction, with promising zero-shot transfer.
2006.04700|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地引入可达性先验解决自动驾驶中的未来预测问题，无需地图先验，具有实际应用价值，值得关注。
2006.04700|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需地图先验的可达性先验方法，结合多假设学习实现自动驾驶场景中物体未来位置和新物体出现的多模态预测。
2006.04700|v2.innovation: 利用语义图估计可达性先验并传播至未来，首次实现新物体出现的预测。
2006.04700|v2.result: 实验显示预测性能提升，并成功实现零样本迁移到未见数据集。

2003.06692|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频和图像中人类情绪识别缺乏上下文感知的问题，提出EmotiCon算法，结合Frege上下文原则，融合多模态（如面部和步态）、语义上下文（通过自注意力CNN）和深度图建模的社会动态交互。在EMOTIC基准上，平均精度达到35.48，比先前方法提升7-8；并引入新数据集GroupWalk，AP为65.83，同样优于先前方法。
2003.06692|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles context-aware emotion recognition by proposing EmotiCon, which integrates multimodal cues, semantic context via self-attention CNN, and depth-based socio-dynamic interactions. It achieves an AP of 35.48 on EMOTIC and 65.83 on a new GroupWalk dataset, outperforming prior methods.
2003.06692|v2.assessment: 该论文在情绪识别领域具有创新性，但与本用户研究领域相关性较低。
2003.06692|v2.contribution: 提出一种结合多模态和上下文原则的情绪识别方法，并引入新数据集。
2003.06692|v2.innovation: 将Frege上下文原则应用于情绪识别，融合三种上下文解释。
2003.06692|v2.result: 在EMOTIC和GroupWalk上均取得显著性能提升。

2001.09691|v2.summary_cn: 针对细粒度动作识别中环境偏差导致的域偏移问题，提出利用多模态（RGB和光流）的对应关系作为自监督对齐方法，结合对抗训练进行无监督域适应。在EPIC-Kitchens的三个厨房数据集上测试，多模态自监督单独提升2.4%，结合对抗训练后比其他UDA方法提升3%。
2001.09691|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses domain shift in fine-grained action recognition by exploiting multimodal correspondence as self-supervised alignment for UDA, combined with adversarial training. On EPIC-Kitchens, it improves over source-only by 2.4% and outperforms other UDA methods by 3%.
2001.09691|v2.assessment: 该论文对视频理解中的域适应有贡献，但相关性一般。
2001.09691|v2.contribution: 提出多模态自监督对齐方法用于无监督域适应。
2001.09691|v2.innovation: 利用模态间对应关系作为自监督信号。

2003.13594|v2.summary_cn: 针对动作识别中依赖人工标注的问题，探索从对话中预测动作的可能性。利用电影剧本训练BERT-based Speech2Action分类器，预测语音片段对应的动作标签，并应用于大规模未标注电影语料库，获得弱标签视频片段。训练后，在标准动作识别基准上取得优越性能，无需任何手动标注动作示例。
2003.13594|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates predicting actions from dialogue, training a BERT-based classifier on screenplays and applying it to unlabelled movies to obtain weak labels. Training on these clips achieves superior action recognition without manual annotations.
2003.13594|v2.assessment: 该论文展示了跨模态监督的潜力，但与本领域相关性较低。
2003.13594|v2.contribution: 提出利用对话作为跨模态监督进行动作识别。
2003.13594|v2.innovation: 从剧本学习动作-语音关联，无需人工标注。
2003.13594|v2.result: 在标准基准上性能优越。

2004.00280|v2.summary_cn: 针对跨模态哈希中监督方法需大量标注而无监督方法精度低的问题，提出利用教师-学生优化，将无监督方法的输出作为指导来训练监督方法。在MIRFlickr和NUS-WIDE基准上，该方法大幅超越所有现有无监督方法。
2004.00280|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes guiding supervised cross-modal hashing with unsupervised outputs via teacher-student optimization. It outperforms all existing unsupervised methods by a large margin on MIRFlickr and NUS-WIDE.
2004.00280|v2.assessment: 该论文在知识蒸馏领域有创新，但相关性较低。
2004.00280|v2.contribution: 提出无监督到监督的知识蒸馏方法。
2004.00280|v2.innovation: 利用无监督输出指导监督训练。
2004.00280|v2.result: 在基准上大幅超越无监督方法。

Cross-Modal Weighting Network for RGB-D.summary_cn: 该论文摘要缺失，无法提供具体内容。
Cross-Modal Weighting Network for RGB-D.summary_en: The abstract is missing, so no summary can be provided.
Cross-Modal Weighting Network for RGB-D.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法评估其质量。
Cross-Modal Weighting Network for RGB-D._arxiv_id: Cross-Modal Weighting Network for RGB-D Salient Object Detection.

Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.summary_cn: ①该论文针对工业设备故障检测中的异常检测问题，旨在从多维多模态传感器数据中识别设备异常状态。②提出了一种基于负采样的可解释多维多模态异常检测方法，通过构建负样本辅助模型学习正常与异常模式的差异，并利用多模态融合提升检测性能。③相比传统单模态或黑盒异常检测方法，该方法强调可解释性，并引入负采样策略以增强对罕见故障的识别能力。④摘要中未提供具体量化数据，但声称在设备故障检测任务上优于基线方法，具体效果需参考全文实验。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.summary_en: This paper addresses anomaly detection for industrial device failure using multidimensional multimodal sensor data. It proposes an interpretable method with negative sampling to enhance discrimination between normal and abnormal patterns via multimodal fusion. Compared to conventional unimodal or black-box approaches, it emphasizes interpretability and robustness to rare faults, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域关联度极低，主要面向工业设备维护，方法通用性有限，但负采样和可解释性思路可借鉴。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.contribution: 提出一种结合负采样与多模态融合的可解释异常检测框架。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.innovation: 将负采样策略引入多维多模态异常检测以提升罕见故障识别能力。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.result: 在设备故障检测任务上声称优于基线，但缺乏具体数据支撑。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo._arxiv_id: Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimodal Anomaly Detection with Negative Sampling for Detection of Device Failure.

WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多模态多跳问答挑战赛（WebQA）的基准测试问题。②提出了一个包含图像和文本的多跳问答数据集，并组织了 NeurIPS 挑战赛。③相比已有工作，该数据集强调跨模态推理和复杂问题求解。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of multimodal multihop question answering by introducing the WebQA benchmark. It proposes a dataset with images and text, organized as a NeurIPS competition to foster research. The key improvement is the emphasis on cross-modal reasoning for complex queries. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.assessment: 作为挑战赛介绍，对多模态推理社区有一定参考价值，但缺乏技术细节和实验数据，重要性有限。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.contribution: 提出了一个多模态多跳问答基准数据集和挑战赛。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.innovation: 强调跨模态多跳推理的评测设计。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha._arxiv_id: WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Challenge.

Multimodal single cell data integration.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对单细胞多模态数据整合的挑战赛结果和经验总结。②提出了一个系统性的基准测试框架，比较了多种整合算法。③相比已有工作，该挑战赛提供了大规模多模态单细胞数据。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Multimodal single cell data integration.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of integrating multimodal single-cell data by presenting results from a community challenge. It proposes a benchmarking framework to compare various integration algorithms. The key improvement is the provision of large-scale multimodal datasets. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Multimodal single cell data integration.assessment: 属于生物信息学领域，与自动驾驶视觉研究相关性极低，仅作为多模态方法参考。
Multimodal single cell data integration.contribution: 提供了单细胞多模态数据整合的基准测试和经验。
Multimodal single cell data integration.innovation: 大规模多模态单细胞数据的挑战赛设计。
Multimodal single cell data integration._arxiv_id: Multimodal single cell data integration challenge: Results and lessons learned.

There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对仅依赖视觉信息的多目标检测与跟踪在复杂场景下鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出了一种自监督方法，通过蒸馏多模态（视觉和声音）知识来增强视觉检测和跟踪模型，无需额外标注。③相比已有工作，创新性地利用声音作为辅助模态，在训练时通过知识蒸馏传递信息，推理时仅需视觉输入。④实验表明，该方法在多个基准上显著提升了检测和跟踪性能，尤其在遮挡和低光照条件下。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness issue of vision-only multi-object detection and tracking in complex scenes. It proposes a self-supervised method that distills multimodal knowledge from audio into a visual model, requiring no extra annotations. The key innovation is using sound as auxiliary modality during training, with inference relying solely on vision. Experiments show significant improvements in detection and tracking, especially under occlusion and low-light conditions.
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.assessment: 该方法将多模态知识蒸馏应用于视觉检测，思路新颖且实用，对自动驾驶感知有潜在借鉴价值。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.contribution: 提出自监督多模态知识蒸馏框架，提升视觉检测与跟踪的鲁棒性。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.innovation: 利用声音模态在训练时提供监督信号，推理时保持纯视觉。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.result: 在多个基准上显著提升检测和跟踪性能。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S._arxiv_id: There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Detection and Tracking With Sound by Distilling Multimodal Knowledge.

Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对雾天环境下车辆检测性能下降的问题，因为相机和激光雷达受天气影响严重。②提出了一种利用互补的激光雷达和雷达信号进行鲁棒多模态车辆检测的方法，通过融合两种传感器的优势来弥补各自缺陷。③相比已有工作，该方法专门针对恶劣天气设计，并利用雷达对雾的穿透能力。④实验表明，在雾天场景下，该方法显著提高了检测精度和召回率，优于单模态和传统融合方法。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.summary_en: This paper addresses the degradation of vehicle detection in foggy weather, where cameras and LiDAR are severely affected. It proposes a robust multimodal detection method that fuses complementary LiDAR and radar signals to leverage radar's penetration capability. The key improvement is the weather-specific design. Experiments show significant gains in precision and recall under foggy conditions, outperforming single-modal and traditional fusion approaches.
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.assessment: 针对自动驾驶恶劣天气感知的实际问题，融合策略具有工程价值，与用户领域高度相关。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.contribution: 提出雾天环境下基于激光雷达和雷达互补融合的车辆检测方法。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.innovation: 利用雷达在雾中的穿透性进行多模态互补。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.result: 在雾天场景下显著提升检测精度和召回率。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F._arxiv_id: Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in Foggy Weather Using Complementary Lidar and Radar Signals.

UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对跨语言跨模态视觉-语言预训练中多语言和多模态对齐不足的问题。②提出了UC2模型，通过双线性注意力网络和跨语言对比学习实现通用跨语言跨模态预训练。③相比已有工作，该方法支持多语言输入，并增强了跨语言迁移能力。④实验表明，在多个跨语言视觉-语言任务上取得了领先性能。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient alignment in cross-lingual and cross-modal vision-language pretraining. It proposes UC2, using bilinear attention networks and cross-lingual contrastive learning for universal pretraining. The key improvement is supporting multilingual inputs and enhancing cross-lingual transfer. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on several cross-lingual vision-language tasks.
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.assessment: 对多语言多模态预训练有贡献，但与自动驾驶视觉核心研究关联较弱。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.contribution: 提出通用跨语言跨模态预训练模型UC2。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.innovation: 结合双线性注意力与跨语言对比学习。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.result: 在多个跨语言视觉-语言任务上取得领先性能。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal._arxiv_id: UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal Vision-and-Language Pre-Training.

Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对非对齐多模态序列中人类情感识别中模态间信息互补不足的问题。②提出了一种渐进式模态强化方法，通过逐步融合和强化各模态特征来提升识别性能。③相比已有工作，该方法处理了非对齐序列，并设计了渐进式融合策略。④实验表明，在多个情感识别基准上取得了显著改进。
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient complementarity in human multimodal emotion recognition from unaligned sequences. It proposes a progressive modality reinforcement method that gradually fuses and enhances modality features. The key improvement is handling unaligned sequences with a progressive fusion strategy. Experiments show significant improvements on multiple emotion recognition benchmarks.
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.assessment: 在多模态融合方法上有一定创新，但领域为情感识别，与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.contribution: 提出渐进式模态强化方法用于非对齐多模态情感识别。
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.innovation: 渐进式融合策略处理非对齐序列。
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.result: 在多个情感识别基准上取得显著改进。
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H._arxiv_id: Progressive Modality Reinforcement for Human Multimodal Emotion Recognition From Unaligned Multimodal Sequences.

Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.summary_cn: ①该论文针对跨模态行人重识别中互信息估计困难的问题。②提出了变分蒸馏方法，通过变分推断替代互信息进行知识迁移。③相比传统基于互信息的方法，避免了高方差估计，提升了训练稳定性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在跨模态任务上优于基线。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of mutual information estimation in cross-modal person re-identification. It proposes a variational distillation method to replace mutual information with variational inference for knowledge transfer. Compared to traditional mutual information-based methods, it avoids high-variance estimation and improves training stability. The abstract lacks specific metrics but claims superiority over baselines in cross-modal tasks.
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.assessment: 该论文聚焦于跨模态蒸馏的理论改进，但与应用广泛的自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.contribution: 提出变分蒸馏框架以改进跨模态知识迁移。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.innovation: 用变分推断替代互信息估计。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.result: 在跨模态行人重识别任务上优于基线。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio._arxiv_id: Farewell to Mutual Information: Variational Distillation for Cross-Modal Person Re-Identification.

2111.12341|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对事件相机数据缺乏标注、难以训练端到端模型的问题。②提出了EvDistill方法，通过双向模态重建模块桥接事件数据和RGB图像，并利用教师网络从大规模标注图像中蒸馏知识到事件数据的学生网络。③相比已有工作，该方法无需配对数据，且重建模块在推理时无额外计算。④实验表明在多个事件数据任务上显著提升性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2111.12341|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of labeled event camera data for end-to-end model training. It proposes EvDistill, which uses a bidirectional modality reconstruction module to bridge event data and RGB images, enabling knowledge distillation from a teacher trained on labeled images to a student on unlabeled events. Unlike prior work, it handles unpaired modalities without extra inference cost. Experiments show significant performance gains on event-based tasks, though specific numbers are omitted.
2111.12341|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了事件相机数据稀缺的实际问题，方法新颖且与多模态感知相关，对自动驾驶中的事件相机应用有参考价值。
2111.12341|v2.contribution: 提出无配对跨模态知识蒸馏框架EvDistill。
2111.12341|v2.innovation: 双向重建模块实现跨模态知识迁移。
2111.12341|v2.result: 在事件数据任务上性能显著提升。

Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.summary_cn: ①该论文针对音频混响脉冲响应合成问题。②提出了跨模态方法从图像生成混响响应。③摘要缺失，无法评估具体改进。④效果未知。
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.summary_en: This paper addresses audio reverb impulse response synthesis. It proposes a cross-modal approach to generate reverb responses from images. The abstract is missing, so specific improvements and results are unknown.
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域无关，且摘要缺失，质量难以评估。
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.contribution: 提出图像到混响的跨模态合成方法。
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.innovation: 利用视觉信息生成音频混响。
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse._arxiv_id: Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse Response Synthesis.

Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多模态多动作视频识别问题。②提出了多模态融合方法以识别视频中的多个动作。③摘要缺失，无法评估具体改进。④效果未知。
Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-modal multi-action video recognition. It proposes a multi-modal fusion method to identify multiple actions in videos. The abstract is missing, so specific improvements and results are unknown.
Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.assessment: 该论文与视频理解相关，但摘要缺失且与自动驾驶核心任务关联有限。
Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.contribution: 提出多模态多动作识别方法。
Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.innovation: 多模态融合用于多动作识别。

Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.summary_cn: ①该论文针对动作检测中RGB表示信息不足的问题。②提出了通过跨模态知识蒸馏学习增强的RGB表示，利用其他模态（如光流）的知识。③相比仅用RGB的模型，增强了时序和运动信息。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在动作检测任务上提升性能。
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient RGB representation for action detection. It proposes learning an augmented RGB representation via cross-modal knowledge distillation from modalities like optical flow. Compared to RGB-only models, it enhances temporal and motion information. The abstract lacks specific metrics but claims improved performance on action detection.
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.assessment: 该论文与多模态蒸馏相关，但动作检测与自动驾驶感知场景有差异，相关性中等。
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.contribution: 提出跨模态蒸馏增强RGB表示。
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.innovation: 利用辅助模态知识改进RGB特征。
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.result: 在动作检测任务上性能提升。
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation._arxiv_id: Learning an Augmented RGB Representation with Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Action Detection.

2012.04124|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多模态Transformer参数过多、难以端到端训练的问题。②提出了参数共享和低秩近似方案，将Transformer分解为模态特定和模态共享部分，减少参数高达97%。③相比固定语言模型的方法，允许端到端训练并学习跨模态信息。④实验表明在音频-视觉视频表示学习任务上有效，且提出基于CNN嵌入的负采样方法。
2012.04124|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses excessive parameters in multimodal Transformers, hindering end-to-end training. It proposes parameter sharing across layers and modalities, decomposing into modality-specific and shared parts, with low-rank approximation, reducing parameters by up to 97%. Unlike fixed language models, it enables end-to-end training and cross-modal learning. Experiments show effectiveness in audio-visual video representation learning, with a novel negative sampling approach.
2012.04124|v2.assessment: 该论文在参数效率和跨模态学习上有显著创新，对多模态感知模型设计有借鉴意义，但视频表示学习与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2012.04124|v2.contribution: 提出高效参数共享的多模态Transformer。
2012.04124|v2.innovation: 低秩近似和模态分解减少参数。
2012.04124|v2.result: 参数减少97%，支持端到端训练。

2007.01179|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态生成模型训练需要大量共享语义的配对数据、成本高昂的问题。②提出一种对比学习框架，通过区分“相关”与“不相关”的多模态数据对来训练生成模型，而非仅依赖共同性。③相比仅利用模态间共同性的方法，该框架能利用大量未标注、未配对的多模态数据，提升数据效率。④实验表明，该方法在多个多模态VAE模型和挑战性数据集上实现了数据高效的训练，并能准确区分相关与不相关样本。
2007.01179|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of paired multimodal data for generative models by proposing a contrastive framework that leverages distinctions between related and unrelated multimodal pairs. It enables data-efficient training of multimodal VAEs and accurate identification of related samples, utilizing unlabeled unpaired data.
2007.01179|v2.assessment: 该工作对多模态生成学习的数据效率有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
2007.01179|v2.contribution: 提出一种利用对比区分相关/不相关多模态数据来提升生成模型数据效率的框架。
2007.01179|v2.innovation: 将对比学习思想引入多模态生成模型训练，利用负样本信息。
2007.01179|v2.result: 在多个数据集上实现数据高效的多模态VAE训练，并准确识别相关样本。

2105.02470|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有自监督多模态生成模型（ELBO近似）在语义连贯性和联合数据分布学习之间存在权衡的问题。②提出一种广义多模态ELBO公式，统一了两种先前方法作为特例，并兼顾两者优势。③通过新的目标函数克服了后验近似导致的权衡限制。④大量实验表明，该方法在自监督生成任务上优于现有最先进模型。
2105.02470|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the trade-off between semantic coherence and joint distribution learning in multimodal ELBO approximations. It proposes a generalized ELBO formulation that subsumes two prior methods and combines their benefits, demonstrating superiority in self-supervised generative tasks.
2105.02470|v2.assessment: 理论贡献扎实，但属于多模态生成基础研究，与自动驾驶感知应用距离较远。
2105.02470|v2.contribution: 提出广义多模态ELBO，统一并改进了现有方法。
2105.02470|v2.innovation: 从理论上推导出更通用的多模态变分目标。
2105.02470|v2.result: 在自监督生成任务上超越现有最先进模型。

HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.summary_cn: ①针对多模态轨迹预测中意图建模不足的问题（摘要缺失，基于标题推断）。②提出HalentNet，通过幻觉意图（hallucinative intents）增强轨迹预测。③可能引入新的意图生成机制以提升预测多样性。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.summary_en: This paper proposes HalentNet for multimodal trajectory forecasting using hallucinative intents, but the abstract is missing, limiting detailed assessment.
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法有效评估其质量和贡献，仅凭标题判断与自动驾驶轨迹预测相关。
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.contribution: 提出一种基于幻觉意图的多模态轨迹预测方法。
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas._arxiv_id: HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecasting with Hallucinative Intents.

Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Vis.summary_cn: ①针对音视频表征学习中主动选择样本以提升对比学习效率的问题（摘要缺失，基于标题推断）。②提出主动对比学习框架，可能通过主动采样策略选择信息量大的样本。③相比被动对比学习，可能提升样本效率和表征质量。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Vis.summary_en: This paper proposes active contrastive learning for audio-visual video representations, likely focusing on sample selection, but the abstract is missing.
Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Vis.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法评估具体贡献，与视频理解相关但非核心自动驾驶方向。
Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Vis.contribution: 提出主动对比学习用于音视频表征。
Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Vis.innovation: 将主动学习与对比学习结合。
Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Vis._arxiv_id: Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Visual Video Representations.

2107.00860|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统NAS方法针对单一数据集从头搜索、计算成本高且跨任务泛化差的问题。②提出MetaD2A模型，通过跨模态潜在空间和摊销元学习，从数据集直接随机生成图（架构），并训练元性能预测器快速评估。③相比任务特定NAS，一次训练即可快速适应新数据集，大幅降低计算成本。④实验表明该方法能有效生成架构并预测性能，实现快速搜索。
2107.00860|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost and poor generalization of task-specific NAS by proposing MetaD2A, which learns to generate architectures from datasets via amortized meta-learning and a meta-performance predictor. It enables rapid architecture search for novel datasets after one-time training.
2107.00860|v2.assessment: NAS方向有创新性，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联度低。
2107.00860|v2.contribution: 提出元学习框架MetaD2A，实现跨数据集的快速架构生成。
2107.00860|v2.innovation: 将数据集映射到架构的跨模态生成。
2107.00860|v2.result: 实验证明能快速生成并预测架构性能。

2106.10110|v2.summary_cn: ①针对主动视觉跟踪中干扰物（distractors）导致跟踪失败的问题。②提出混合合作-竞争多智能体博弈，目标与多个干扰物协作对抗跟踪器，通过博弈学习使干扰物涌现多样干扰行为，暴露跟踪器弱点。③提出干扰物奖励函数、跨模态师生学习策略和跟踪器循环注意力机制。④实验表明跟踪器在干扰环境下表现鲁棒，并能泛化到未知环境，博弈还可用于对抗性测试跟踪器鲁棒性。
2106.10110|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses distraction-robust active visual tracking by proposing a mixed cooperative-competitive multi-agent game where distractors learn to adversarially challenge the tracker. Practical methods including reward design, cross-modal teacher-student learning, and recurrent attention enhance robustness, with experiments showing strong generalization and adversarial testing utility.
2106.10110|v2.assessment: 与自动驾驶中的多目标跟踪和鲁棒感知相关，博弈思想有启发性，实验较充分。
2106.10110|v2.contribution: 提出多智能体博弈框架增强主动跟踪的干扰鲁棒性。
2106.10110|v2.innovation: 将合作-竞争博弈用于训练干扰物以暴露跟踪器弱点。
2106.10110|v2.result: 跟踪器在干扰场景下表现鲁棒并泛化至未知环境。

2102.05766|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对语音与文本统一表示学习的问题，现有方法仅从单一模态学习，无法有效利用大规模文本和语音数据，且受限于平行语音翻译数据的稀缺性。②提出了FAT-MLM（融合声学与文本掩码语言模型），联合学习语音和文本的统一表示，并在此基础上提出端到端的语音翻译模型FAT-ST。③改进点在于利用多种语料（包括语音识别、机器翻译平行数据及纯语音和文本数据）进行跨模态预训练，突破了单一模态和并行数据限制。④在三个翻译方向上，通过FAT-MLM微调，翻译质量最高提升+5.9 BLEU。
2102.05766|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of learning unified representations for speech and text, which existing methods fail to do due to single-modality training and scarce parallel speech translation data. It proposes FAT-MLM, a fused acoustic and text masked language model that jointly learns cross-modal representations from diverse corpora, and FAT-ST for end-to-end speech translation. Fine-tuning from FAT-MLM improves translation quality by up to +5.9 BLEU across three directions.
2102.05766|v2.assessment: 该论文在语音-文本多模态预训练领域有创新，但与自动驾驶感知方向关联极低，仅适合作为多模态学习的背景参考。
2102.05766|v2.contribution: 提出了一种融合声学与文本的跨模态预训练框架，统一了语音和文本表示。
2102.05766|v2.innovation: 利用多种非平行语料进行跨模态掩码语言建模，突破了平行数据限制。
2102.05766|v2.result: 在语音翻译任务上最高提升5.9 BLEU。

2110.13309|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉-语言导航（VLN）中历史信息建模不足的问题，现有方法多使用循环状态记忆，难以处理长时程依赖。②提出了历史感知多模态Transformer（HAMT），通过分层视觉Transformer编码全景观测，结合文本、历史和当前观测进行动作预测。③改进点在于用层次化ViT建模图像内、全景内和全景间的关系，并联合代理任务和强化学习训练。④在R2R、RxR、REVERIE、CVDN等多个VLN基准上取得了新最优结果。
2110.13309|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of inadequate history modeling in vision-and-language navigation, where recurrent states limit long-horizon memory. It introduces HAMT, a history-aware multimodal transformer that hierarchically encodes panoramic observations with ViT and integrates text, history, and current view for action prediction. HAMT achieves state-of-the-art results on R2R, RxR, REVERIE, and CVDN benchmarks.
2110.13309|v2.assessment: 该论文在多模态决策和Transformer架构上有参考价值，但面向室内导航，与自动驾驶的室外感知场景差异较大。
2110.13309|v2.contribution: 提出了历史感知多模态Transformer，有效编码长时程视觉历史用于导航决策。
2110.13309|v2.innovation: 分层ViT结构同时建模图像内、空间和时间关系。
2110.13309|v2.result: 在多个VLN基准上达到最先进性能。

Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.summary_cn: ①该论文针对语言到视觉的语义空间可解释性问题，旨在通过跨模态对比学习将语言概念锚定到视觉特征。②提出了基于跨模态对比学习的框架，将文本语义映射到视觉空间，构建可解释的语义表示。③改进点在于利用对比学习增强模态对齐，提升语义空间的解释性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.summary_en: This paper addresses the interpretability of semantic spaces by grounding language to vision via cross-modal contrastive learning. It proposes a framework that aligns textual semantics with visual features to build explainable representations. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.assessment: 该论文摘要不完整，方法细节和实验缺失，质量评估受限，与自动驾驶相关性较低。
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.contribution: 提出用跨模态对比学习构建可解释的视觉-语言语义空间。
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.innovation: 将对比学习用于语义空间的可解释性增强。
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding._arxiv_id: Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding Language to Vision with Cross-Modal Contrastive Learning.

2110.14202|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多模态元学习中知识迁移的理解不足问题，现有研究声称多模态元学习器优于单模态专用学习器，但缺乏深入验证。②提出了量化不同模态任务间知识迁移的方法，借鉴多任务学习中的迁移概念，进行微观层面的任务级分析。③改进点在于首次从多任务学习视角系统分析多模态元学习的知识迁移机制。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但提供了理论分析框架。
