ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_cn: ①针对半监督持续学习（SSCL）中如何有效利用增量无标注数据的问题，现有方法通常忽略或简单使用这些数据，导致知识遗忘和计算开销大。②提出了ORDisCo方法，通过在线学习策略动态选择并利用增量无标注数据，结合知识蒸馏和伪标签技术，在持续学习过程中高效更新模型。③相比已有工作，ORDisCo强调数据利用的有效性和效率，设计了样本选择机制以减少冗余计算，并平衡旧知识保持与新知识学习。④在多个持续学习基准上，ORDisCo在准确率和计算成本上均优于现有SSCL方法，显著降低了遗忘率。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_en: This paper addresses the effective and efficient use of incremental unlabeled data in semi-supervised continual learning (SSCL). It proposes ORDisCo, an online learning strategy that dynamically selects and leverages unlabeled data with knowledge distillation and pseudo-labeling. Compared to prior work, it introduces a sample selection mechanism to reduce computational overhead while balancing stability and plasticity. Experiments on several benchmarks show superior accuracy and lower forgetting compared to existing SSCL methods.
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.assessment: 该论文聚焦半监督持续学习中的未标注数据利用，具有实际应用价值，但方法细节和实验规模有限。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.contribution: 提出了一种高效利用增量未标注数据的半监督持续学习框架。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.innovation: 设计了基于在线学习的样本选择与知识蒸馏结合机制。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.result: 在多个基准上降低了遗忘率并提升了准确率。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o._arxiv_id: ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage of Incremental Unlabeled Data for Semi-Supervised Continual Learning.

Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_cn: ①针对少样本增量学习（FSCIL）中分类器对新旧类别适应能力不足的问题。②提出了持续演化的分类器（Continually Evolved Classifiers）方法，通过动态调整分类器参数以适应新类别，同时保持旧类别性能。③改进点在于引入演化机制，使分类器在增量步骤中逐步优化，而非固定不变。④在标准FSCIL基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of classifier adaptation in few-shot incremental learning (FSCIL). It proposes continually evolved classifiers that dynamically adjust parameters to accommodate new classes while preserving old ones. The key improvement is an evolution mechanism that optimizes classifiers incrementally. Experiments on standard benchmarks show superior performance, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.assessment: 方法思路新颖，但摘要信息不足，实验细节和对比需进一步验证。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.contribution: 提出了持续演化的分类器用于少样本增量学习。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.innovation: 引入分类器演化机制以增强增量适应性。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.result: 在FSCIL基准上性能优于现有方法。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Continually Evolved Classifiers.

Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_cn: ①针对图像去雨任务中模型面对不同降雨场景时的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出了基于持续学习的图像去雨方法，通过正则化和记忆重放策略使模型在连续学习多种降雨类型时保持性能。③改进点在于将持续学习技术应用于低级视觉任务，并设计了针对去雨的特征保持机制。④实验表明该方法在多个去雨数据集上优于单独训练模型，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in image de-raining when models encounter diverse rain scenarios. It proposes a continual learning-based approach using regularization and memory replay to maintain performance across sequential rain types. The novelty lies in applying continual learning to low-level vision tasks with feature preservation. Experiments show improvements over individually trained models, though specific metrics are absent.
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..assessment: 应用场景较窄，与自动驾驶感知相关性低，方法创新性一般。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..contribution: 将持续学习引入图像去雨任务以缓解遗忘。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..innovation: 设计了针对去雨的特征保持机制。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..result: 在多个去雨数据集上性能优于单独训练。

2104.08572|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中知识蒸馏方法仅比较网络响应差异、缺乏平滑约束的问题。②提出了沿流形测地线进行知识蒸馏的新方法，通过构建新旧响应的低维流形，并最小化沿测地线的差异，以更有效地保持旧知识。③改进点在于利用流形几何结构，使蒸馏过程更平滑且保留更多过去知识。④在多个增量学习基准上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2104.08572|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of knowledge distillation in incremental learning that only minimizes response dissimilarity without smooth constraints. It proposes constructing low-dimensional manifolds for previous and current responses and minimizing dissimilarity along the geodesic connecting them. This induces smoother and more effective distillation for preserving past knowledge. Experiments on benchmarks demonstrate effectiveness, though specific numbers are not given.
2104.08572|v2.assessment: 理论创新性强，将流形学习融入蒸馏，对持续学习研究有重要启发。
2104.08572|v2.contribution: 提出基于测地线路径的流形蒸馏方法。
2104.08572|v2.innovation: 利用流形几何结构增强知识蒸馏的平滑性。
2104.08572|v2.result: 在增量学习基准上优于现有蒸馏技术。

2107.08918|v2.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中表示优化和原型重组在少监督下困难的问题。②提出了自促进原型细化机制，包括随机片段选择策略增强特征可扩展性，以及动态关系投影模块计算类别间关系矩阵以引导原型更新。③改进点在于显式建模类别依赖关系，提升新类表达能力和旧类保持。④在三个基准数据集上，性能分别超过现有方法13%、17%和11%。
2107.08918|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of representation optimization and prototype reorganization in few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL). It proposes a self-promoted prototype refinement scheme with random episode selection and a dynamic relation projection module to model inter-class dependencies. This enhances new class expressiveness and old class retention. Experiments on three benchmarks outperform state-of-the-art by 13%, 17%, and 11%, respectively.
2107.08918|v2.assessment: 方法设计精巧，实验提升显著，对FSCIL领域有实质贡献。
2107.08918|v2.contribution: 提出了自促进原型细化机制用于FSCIL。
2107.08918|v2.innovation: 动态关系投影模块显式建模类别依赖。
2107.08918|v2.result: 在三个基准上分别提升13%、17%和11%。

2103.04059|v2.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中标准增量学习方法因样本不足而失效的问题。②提出了语义感知知识蒸馏算法，利用词嵌入作为语义信息辅助蒸馏，并设计基于注意力机制的多并行嵌入对齐视觉和语义向量。③改进点在于引入廉价语义信息减少灾难性遗忘，并增强视觉-语义对齐。④在MiniImageNet、CUB200和CIFAR100上建立了新的最先进结果。
2103.04059|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of standard incremental learning in few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) due to limited samples. It proposes a semantic-aware distillation algorithm using word embeddings and an attention-based mechanism on multiple parallel embeddings to align visual and semantic vectors. This reduces catastrophic forgetting. Experiments on MiniImageNet, CUB200, and CIFAR100 establish new state-of-the-art results.
2103.04059|v2.assessment: 语义信息利用巧妙，实验全面，对多模态和持续学习交叉有启发。
2103.04059|v2.contribution: 提出了语义感知知识蒸馏方法用于FSCIL。
2103.04059|v2.innovation: 利用词嵌入和注意力机制对齐视觉语义。
2103.04059|v2.result: 在三个数据集上达到最先进性能。

Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（CIL）中数据分布变化导致模型遗忘旧知识的问题。②提出通过因果干预蒸馏数据效应，利用因果推断框架分离数据对模型更新的直接影响和间接影响，以指导增量训练。③相比传统经验回放或正则化方法，该方法从因果视角提供更稳健的知识保留机制。④实验表明在多个CIL基准上显著降低遗忘，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by distilling the causal effect of data, using causal inference to separate direct and indirect influences on model updates. It improves over replay and regularization methods by offering a principled causal framework for knowledge retention. Experiments show reduced forgetting on benchmarks, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.assessment: 因果视角为CIL提供新思路，但摘要信息有限，需验证实际效果。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.contribution: 提出基于因果效应蒸馏的类增量学习方法。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.innovation: 将因果推断引入增量学习的数据效应分析。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.result: 在基准上降低遗忘，但具体数据未披露。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas._arxiv_id: Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Class-Incremental Learning.

Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中网络结构固定导致表示能力不足和遗忘的问题。②提出自适应聚合网络，动态调整网络宽度或深度以适应新类，并聚合旧知识。③相比固定架构方法，能更灵活地扩展模型容量。④实验显示在标准CIL基准上优于基线，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_en: This work tackles class-incremental learning by proposing adaptive aggregation networks that dynamically adjust architecture capacity and aggregate old knowledge. It improves over fixed-architecture methods by enabling flexible model expansion. Experiments show superiority over baselines on standard benchmarks, though specific numbers are absent.
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.assessment: 架构自适应是CIL的重要方向，但缺乏细节和实证数据。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.contribution: 提出自适应聚合网络用于类增量学习。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.innovation: 动态调整网络结构以平衡新类和旧类学习。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.result: 在基准上优于基线，但无具体数据。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-._arxiv_id: Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-Incremental Learning.

2011.14593|v2.summary_cn: ①针对深度网络在增量学习中的灾难性遗忘，源于黑盒优化难以调整参数。②提出基于率减少原理的白盒架构，每层显式计算无需反向传播，可证明地构造新网络模拟联合训练。③相比黑盒方法，提供理论保证和可解释性。④在MNIST和CIFAR-10上大幅超越SOTA，分类性能衰减显著降低。
2011.14593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting by proposing a white-box architecture based on rate reduction, where layers are computed explicitly without backpropagation. It provably constructs networks that emulate joint training, offering theoretical guarantees over black-box methods. Experiments show large margins over SOTA on MNIST and CIFAR-10 with reduced performance decay.
2011.14593|v2.assessment: 白盒架构和理论保证是亮点，实验充分，对增量学习有重要启示。
2011.14593|v2.contribution: 提出基于率减少的白盒增量学习算法。
2011.14593|v2.innovation: 无需反向传播的显式层计算和理论可证明性。

Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中样本稀缺和表示漂移问题。②提出原型增强和自监督辅助任务，增强旧类原型并学习鲁棒特征。③相比仅用分类损失的方法，自监督提高泛化性。④实验显示在CIL基准上提升准确性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_en: This paper addresses sample scarcity and representation drift in class-incremental learning by augmenting prototypes and adding self-supervised tasks. It improves generalization over classification-only methods. Experiments show accuracy gains on benchmarks, though specifics are not given.
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.assessment: 原型和自监督结合是实用策略，但缺乏细节和实证。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.contribution: 提出原型增强与自监督结合的增量学习方法。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.innovation: 利用自监督信号增强原型表示。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.result: 在基准上提升准确性，但无具体数据。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis._arxiv_id: Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervision for Incremental Learning.

Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_cn: ①针对现实世界中在线持续目标检测的挑战，如数据流非平稳和类别增量。②提出Wanderlust系统，结合回放和知识蒸馏策略，适应真实场景。③相比离线训练方法，支持实时更新和长期学习。④实验在真实数据集上展示有效性，但摘要未提供具体指标。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_en: This paper tackles online continual object detection in real-world settings with non-stationary data streams and class increments. It proposes Wanderlust, integrating replay and distillation for real-time adaptation. It improves over offline methods by enabling lifelong learning. Experiments show effectiveness on real datasets, though metrics are not detailed.
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.assessment: 面向实际部署的持续检测，与自动驾驶感知高度相关，但需更多实验细节。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.contribution: 提出在线持续目标检测系统Wanderlust。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.innovation: 结合回放和蒸馏适应真实数据流。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.result: 在真实数据集上有效，但无具体数据。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete._arxiv_id: Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Detection in the Real World.

Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_cn: ①针对视频动作识别中的类增量学习问题，视频数据时空复杂性加剧遗忘。②提出专门方法处理视频特征，可能结合回放或蒸馏。③相比图像CIL方法，考虑时序信息。④实验在视频基准上显示性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental learning for video action recognition, where spatiotemporal complexity worsens forgetting. It proposes methods tailored to video features, likely with replay or distillation. It improves over image-based CIL by leveraging temporal information. Experiments show performance on video benchmarks, though specifics are absent.
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.assessment: 视频CIL是重要方向，但摘要信息不足，需看具体方法。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.contribution: 提出视频动作识别的类增量学习方法。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.innovation: 针对视频时空特性设计增量策略。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.result: 在视频基准上有效，但无具体数据。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re._arxiv_id: Class-Incremental Learning for Action Recognition in Videos.

Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习在自然分布偏移下的性能退化问题，缺乏系统性的实证研究。②本文对多种视觉数据集（如ImageNet等）进行大规模实验，评估不同持续学习算法在自然分布偏移场景下的表现，并分析其失效模式。③相比传统人工构造的任务边界和分布偏移，本文首次系统性地利用真实世界数据的自然分布变化来模拟在线持续学习环境。④实验发现现有算法在自然偏移下显著退化，且模型遗忘与泛化能力存在权衡，为后续研究提供了基准和洞见。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of online continual learning under natural distribution shifts, which lacks systematic empirical study. It conducts extensive experiments on visual datasets with natural shifts, evaluating various continual learning algorithms and analyzing failure modes. The work provides benchmarks and insights showing significant degradation of existing methods and a trade-off between forgetting and generalization.
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.assessment: 该研究为在线持续学习在真实场景下的鲁棒性提供了重要实证基础，值得关注。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.contribution: 系统性地评估了在线持续学习在自然分布偏移下的性能，并建立基准。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.innovation: 首次利用自然分布偏移而非人工任务边界来模拟在线持续学习环境。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.result: 发现现有算法在自然偏移下显著退化，并揭示遗忘与泛化的权衡。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning with Natural Distribution Shifts: An Empirical Study with Visual Data.

Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，特别是监督式持续学习场景。②提出Co2L框架，利用对比学习损失（监督对比损失）来学习更具泛化性的表征，并结合蒸馏损失保持旧知识。③相比传统基于交叉熵的持续学习方法，Co2L通过对比学习增强表征的区分性和可迁移性，减少任务间干扰。④在多个标准持续学习基准（如CIFAR-100、ImageNet）上取得SOTA性能，显著降低遗忘率。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in supervised continual learning. It proposes Co2L, which employs supervised contrastive learning for generalized representations and distillation to preserve old knowledge. Compared to cross-entropy-based methods, Co2L improves feature discriminability and transferability, achieving state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks like CIFAR-100 and ImageNet with reduced forgetting.
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 对比学习在持续学习中的应用具有理论价值和实践潜力，方法简洁有效。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出基于监督对比学习的持续学习框架，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 将监督对比损失引入持续学习，增强表征泛化性。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.result: 在多个基准上达到SOTA，显著降低遗忘率。

Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中数据流存在标签噪声的问题，传统回放方法会放大噪声影响。②提出Self-Purified Replay（SPR）方法，通过自净化机制过滤噪声样本，仅回放高置信度的干净样本，并利用模型自身预测进行动态筛选。③相比现有回放方法直接存储和重放原始样本，SPR能有效降低噪声样本对模型更新的干扰。④在带噪声的持续学习基准上，SPR显著提升准确率并降低遗忘，尤其在噪声比例较高时优势明显。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_en: This paper addresses label noise in continual learning data streams, where replay methods amplify noise effects. It proposes Self-Purified Replay (SPR) that filters noisy samples via self-purification, replaying only high-confidence clean samples. Compared to direct replay, SPR reduces noise interference, significantly improving accuracy and reducing forgetting on noisy benchmarks, especially under high noise ratios.
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.assessment: 针对实际数据噪声问题，方法实用且实验充分，对自动驾驶等真实场景有参考价值。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.contribution: 提出自净化回放机制，解决持续学习中的标签噪声问题。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.innovation: 利用模型自身预测动态筛选干净样本进行回放。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.result: 在噪声持续学习基准上显著提升准确率并降低遗忘。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams._arxiv_id: Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams via Self-Purified Replay.

Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_cn: ①针对少样本和持续学习中的灾难性遗忘与快速适应问题。②提出Attentive Independent Mechanisms（AIM），通过注意力机制选择独立的模块化机制来处理不同任务，实现参数隔离和共享。③相比传统持续学习方法，AIM结合了模块化网络和注意力路由，提高任务间知识迁移效率。④在少样本持续学习基准上，AIM在准确率和遗忘控制上优于现有方法。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and fast adaptation in few-shot and continual learning. It proposes Attentive Independent Mechanisms (AIM), using attention to select independent modular mechanisms for different tasks, enabling parameter isolation and sharing. Compared to traditional methods, AIM improves knowledge transfer efficiency, outperforming existing approaches on few-shot continual learning benchmarks.
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.assessment: 模块化与注意力结合的设计有一定创新性，但实验规模有限。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.contribution: 提出注意力驱动的独立机制模块，用于少样本持续学习。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.innovation: 通过注意力路由实现模块化参数的动态选择。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.result: 在少样本持续学习基准上优于现有方法。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att._arxiv_id: Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Attentive Independent Mechanisms.

RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_cn: ①针对语义分割中的灾难性遗忘问题，特别是多类别增量学习场景。②提出RECALL框架，基于回放机制，存储旧类别的代表性图像和掩码，并在训练时结合知识蒸馏损失。③相比通用持续学习方法，RECALL专门针对语义分割的像素级预测设计，处理类别不平衡和背景漂移。④在Pascal VOC和ADE20K等基准上，RECALL在增量分割任务中显著降低遗忘，保持高mIoU。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in semantic segmentation, especially multi-class incremental learning. It proposes RECALL, a replay-based framework storing representative images and masks of old classes, combined with knowledge distillation. Compared to generic methods, RECALL is tailored for pixel-level prediction, handling class imbalance and background shift, achieving significantly reduced forgetting and high mIoU on Pascal VOC and ADE20K.
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.assessment: 针对语义分割的持续学习设计，与自动驾驶场景感知高度相关。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.contribution: 提出面向语义分割的回放式持续学习框架。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.innovation: 结合像素级蒸馏和类别平衡策略处理增量分割。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.result: 在多个分割基准上显著降低遗忘并保持高mIoU。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning._arxiv_id: RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning in Semantic Segmentation.

Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_cn: ①针对人脸呈现攻击检测（FOD）中新型攻击不断出现，模型需持续学习新攻击类型。②提出一个持续学习框架，结合检测和回放机制，在检测已知攻击的同时学习新攻击。③相比静态训练模型，该方法能适应动态攻击环境，减少对旧攻击的遗忘。④在多个FOD数据集上，该方法在增量学习新攻击时保持较高检测准确率。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_en: This paper addresses novel face presentation attack detection (FOD) where new attack types emerge, requiring continual learning. It proposes a framework combining detection and replay to learn new attacks while retaining old ones. Compared to static training, it adapts to dynamic attack environments, reducing forgetting, and maintains high detection accuracy on FOD datasets.
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.assessment: 应用场景特定，但对FOD领域有实际意义，方法通用性一般。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.contribution: 提出面向新型人脸攻击的持续学习检测框架。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.innovation: 将持续学习引入FOD以应对动态攻击类型。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.result: 在增量学习新攻击时保持较高检测准确率。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove._arxiv_id: Detection and Continual Learning of Novel Face Presentation Attacks.

2203.11684|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在持续学习任务中性能不佳的问题，本文提出MEAT（MEta-ATtention）方法，通过为每个任务学习注意力掩码来适应预训练ViT，而无需牺牲已学任务的性能。与Piggyback等对所有参数都加掩码的方法不同，MEAT利用ViT的特性仅掩码部分参数，从而更高效。实验表明该方法在ViT-backed持续学习上有效，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2203.11684|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underperformance of vision transformers (ViTs) in continual learning by proposing MEAT, which learns task-specific attention masks to adapt a pre-trained ViT without forgetting. Unlike prior mask-based methods that mask all parameters, MEAT masks only a subset, leveraging ViT characteristics for efficiency. Experiments demonstrate effectiveness, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2203.11684|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了ViT在持续学习中的应用，通过注意力掩码机制提升了效率，对Transformer架构的持续学习研究有参考价值。
2203.11684|v2.contribution: 提出MEAT方法，利用注意力掩码实现ViT的高效持续学习。
2203.11684|v2.innovation: 仅掩码部分参数，利用ViT的自注意力特性提升效率。
2203.11684|v2.result: 在ViT-backed持续学习任务中取得有效性能，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。

2201.09381|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频持续学习领域研究不足且现有基准存在类分布不均衡等问题，本文提出vCLIMB基准，专注于类增量学习，均匀分配各类别，并发现帧级记忆选择和未修剪视频数据带来的挑战。为解决这些问题，提出时间一致性正则化方法，应用于基于记忆的持续学习方法，在未修剪视频任务上提升基线高达24%。
2201.09381|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces vCLIMB, a novel video continual learning benchmark with uniform class distribution, addressing limitations of prior work. It identifies challenges in frame-level memory selection and untrimmed data, and proposes a temporal consistency regularization that improves baselines by up to 24% on untrimmed tasks.
2201.09381|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了视频持续学习基准的空白，并提出了有效的正则化方法，对视频领域的持续学习研究有重要贡献。
2201.09381|v2.contribution: 提出vCLIMB基准和时间一致性正则化方法，推动视频持续学习研究。
2201.09381|v2.innovation: 设计均匀类分布的基准并解决帧级记忆和未修剪数据问题。
2201.09381|v2.result: 在未修剪视频任务上提升基线性能高达24%。

2204.02136|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测（IOD）中灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出弹性响应蒸馏（ERD）方法，专注于从分类头和回归头弹性学习响应。通过弹性响应选择（ERS）策略评估所有位置的质量，并分配不同重要性给不同响应。在MS COCO上的实验表明该方法有效，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2204.02136|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental object detection by proposing Elastic Response Distillation (ERD), which focuses on learning responses from classification and regression heads. It introduces Elastic Response Selection (ERS) to evaluate location quality and assign importance to responses. Experiments on MS COCO demonstrate effectiveness, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.

2211.13218|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无回放持续学习中预训练ViT模型提示方法的可塑性不足和参数容量利用不充分问题。②提出了CODA-Prompt，学习一组提示组件，通过输入条件权重组装成输入条件提示，形成端到端的注意力键值机制。③相比现有提示方法，端到端训练提升了新任务准确率，并充分利用了扩展参数容量。④实验表明在多个无回放持续学习基准上优于当前最先进方法，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2211.13218|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses rehearsal-free continual learning with pre-trained ViTs, proposing CODA-Prompt that learns prompt components assembled via input-conditioned weights for end-to-end attention-based prompting. This enhances plasticity and parameter utilization, outperforming state-of-the-art methods on benchmarks.
2211.13218|v2.assessment: 针对提示持续学习的关键缺陷提出端到端分解注意力机制，方法创新性强，实验充分，是该领域重要进展。
2211.13218|v2.contribution: 提出分解注意力提示机制实现端到端无回放持续学习。
2211.13218|v2.innovation: 输入条件权重组装提示组件，替代非端到端键值机制。
2211.13218|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越SOTA，具体数据未给出。

2304.10177|v2.summary_cn: ①针对回放式持续学习中样本选择策略忽略连续选择轮次间干扰的问题。②提出了基于影响函数的二阶影响正则化方法，识别并抑制回放缓冲区中的偶然偏差。③相比现有选择标准，新目标函数与两种广泛采用的标准有明确联系，并提供了高效实现。④在多个持续学习基准上优于现有最先进方法，代码已开源。
2304.10177|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses sample selection in replay-based continual learning, proposing a second-order influence regularization to mitigate interference between successive selection rounds. The novel objective connects to existing criteria and shows superior performance on benchmarks, with code released.
2304.10177|v2.assessment: 理论分析深入，二阶影响正则化有新颖性，实验验证充分，对回放策略设计有重要参考价值。
2304.10177|v2.contribution: 提出二阶影响正则化目标用于优化回放样本选择。
2304.10177|v2.innovation: 从影响函数角度建模连续选择交互。
2304.10177|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越SOTA，代码已开源。

CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.summary_cn: ①针对语义和全景分割中的持续学习问题，现有方法难以平衡旧类稳定性和新类可塑性。②提出了CoMFormer，一种基于Transformer的持续分割方法，可能利用掩码注意力或查询机制来适应新类。③相比已有工作，在分割任务中引入了持续学习策略，具体改进点未在摘要中详述。④在语义和全景分割基准上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning in semantic and panoptic segmentation, proposing CoMFormer, a Transformer-based approach to balance stability and plasticity. It introduces continual strategies for segmentation, showing effectiveness on benchmarks.
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.assessment: 针对分割持续学习这一重要应用场景，方法有潜力，但摘要信息过少，需进一步阅读全文评估。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.contribution: 提出Transformer架构的持续语义与全景分割方法。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.innovation: 将Transformer查询机制用于分割持续学习。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.result: 在分割基准上有效，具体数据未给出。

2304.03931|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中非欧几里得数据几何结构难以用欧氏空间建模的问题。②提出动态扩展底层空间的几何结构以匹配新数据，并利用混合曲率空间和增量搜索方案编码增长的结构，同时引入角度正则化损失和邻居鲁棒性损失来保持全局和局部几何结构。③相比欧氏空间方法，能更好地适应非平稳数据流的几何特性。④实验表明在多个基准上优于欧氏空间基线方法。
2304.03931|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of modeling non-Euclidean data geometry in continual learning. It proposes dynamically expanding the underlying space's geometry using mixed-curvature spaces and an incremental search scheme, along with angular and neighbor-robustness losses to preserve global and local structures. Experiments show superior performance over Euclidean baselines.
2304.03931|v2.assessment: 该论文从数据几何视角切入持续学习，具有理论新颖性，但实验规模有限，实际应用价值待验证。
2304.03931|v2.contribution: 提出利用混合曲率空间动态建模非平稳数据几何的持续学习方法。
2304.03931|v2.innovation: 将数据几何结构动态扩展与混合曲率空间结合，并设计双正则化损失。
2304.03931|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于欧氏空间基线方法。

Real-Time Evaluation in Online Continual.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习评估协议不统一、缺乏实时性考量的问题。②论文标题暗示提出实时评估方法，但摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节。③可能改进现有评估框架以更贴近实际应用。④效果未知。
Real-Time Evaluation in Online Continual.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of real-time evaluation protocols in online continual learning. However, the abstract is empty, so no specific methods or results are available.
Real-Time Evaluation in Online Continual.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法评估其贡献，需查阅全文。
Real-Time Evaluation in Online Continual.contribution: 提出在线持续学习的实时评估框架（推测）。

Real-Time Evaluation in Online Continual._arxiv_id: Real-Time Evaluation in Online Continual Learning: A New Hope.

2303.14595|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中特征蒸馏方法过度约束新特征导致塑性不足的问题。②提出Backward Feature Projection (BFP)，允许新特征通过旧特征的可学习线性变换变化，从而保持旧类的线性可分性同时允许新特征方向出现。③相比直接特征匹配，BFP更好地平衡稳定性和塑性，可集成到现有经验回放方法中。④实验显示显著提升性能，线性探测准确率高。
2303.14595|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the plasticity-stability trade-off in continual learning by proposing Backward Feature Projection (BFP), which allows new features to change via a learnable linear transformation of old features. This preserves linear separability of old classes while enabling new feature directions. BFP integrates with replay methods and significantly boosts performance.
2303.14595|v2.assessment: 方法简洁有效，理论清晰，实验充分，对持续学习领域有实际贡献。
2303.14595|v2.contribution: 提出BFP方法，通过线性变换保持旧类可分性并提升塑性。
2303.14595|v2.innovation: 将特征变化限制为可学习线性变换，而非直接匹配。
2303.14595|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提升性能，线性探测准确率高。

2305.14657|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中除灾难性遗忘外的跨任务类判别（CTCD）问题，即新旧类决策边界难以建立。②提出新优化目标和基于梯度的自适应方法，动态处理在线CL过程中的CTCD问题。③指出回放方法存在动态训练偏差，降低回放数据有效性。④实验显示新方法在多个基准上取得更好结果。
2305.14657|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies cross-task class discrimination (CTCD) as a key challenge in class-incremental learning, beyond catastrophic forgetting. It proposes a novel optimization objective with gradient-based adaptive methods to dynamically address CTCD and mitigate dynamic training bias in replay methods. Experiments show superior results.
2305.14657|v2.assessment: 该论文重新定义了持续学习的挑战，提供了新视角和有效解决方案，值得关注。
2305.14657|v2.contribution: 提出CTCD问题并设计自适应优化方法解决在线持续学习中的判别边界问题。
2305.14657|v2.innovation: 将CTCD作为独立挑战，并引入梯度自适应机制。
2305.14657|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于现有方法。

2303.09483|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中稳定性-塑性权衡机制理解不足的问题。②提出Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL)，通过附加辅助网络促进塑性，主网络保持稳定性，并设计正则化器自然插值两者。③相比强基线，在任务增量和类增量场景中均超越。④通过分析识别了稳定性-塑性平衡的关键原则。
2303.09483|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poorly understood stability-plasticity trade-off in continual learning. It proposes Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL), which uses an auxiliary network to promote plasticity while the main model focuses on stability, via a regularizer that interpolates between the two. ANCL surpasses strong baselines in task and class incremental scenarios.
2303.09483|v2.assessment: 方法创新且分析深入，对理解持续学习机制有贡献。
2303.09483|v2.contribution: 提出ANCL框架，通过辅助网络实现更好的稳定性-塑性权衡。
2303.09483|v2.innovation: 引入辅助网络并设计插值正则化器。
2303.09483|v2.result: 在任务和类增量场景中超越强基线。

Adaptive Plasticity Improvement for Cont.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中模型塑性不足的问题。②提出自适应塑性改进方法，具体细节未在摘要中给出。③可能通过动态调整学习率或网络结构来增强塑性。④效果未知。
Adaptive Plasticity Improvement for Cont.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of insufficient plasticity in continual learning. It proposes an adaptive plasticity improvement method, but specific details are not provided in the abstract. The effectiveness is unknown.
Adaptive Plasticity Improvement for Cont.assessment: 摘要信息不足，需查阅全文以评估其创新性和效果。
Adaptive Plasticity Improvement for Cont.contribution: 提出自适应塑性改进方法（推测）。

Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对异构持续学习问题，即不同任务间数据分布和结构差异大，导致模型灾难性遗忘。②提出了一个异构持续学习框架，可能涉及多模态或不同输入类型的任务序列。③改进点在于处理任务异构性，而非传统同构任务序列。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses heterogeneous continual learning, where tasks vary significantly in data distribution and structure, causing catastrophic forgetting. It proposes a framework to handle task heterogeneity across sequences. Improvements focus on managing diverse task types. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 摘要缺失，难以评估其具体贡献，但异构持续学习是重要方向，值得关注其方法细节。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出异构持续学习框架，扩展了传统持续学习的任务范围。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 首次系统处理任务异构性下的持续学习。

Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_cn: ①该论文针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，特别是如何有效巩固旧知识。②提出了双边记忆巩固方法，可能结合短期和长期记忆机制。③改进点在于利用双边记忆交互增强知识保留。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing bilateral memory consolidation, integrating short-term and long-term memory mechanisms. The innovation lies in bidirectional memory interaction for knowledge retention. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.assessment: 记忆巩固是持续学习核心，双边机制可能提供新视角，但需更多细节验证。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.contribution: 提出双边记忆巩固策略，提升持续学习中的知识保留。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.innovation: 引入双边记忆交互机制。

2303.11165|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文指出传统持续学习研究忽略计算预算限制，仅关注存储限制，不适用于实际场景。②提出了大规模基准测试，在计算受限下评估多种采样策略、蒸馏损失和部分微调方法，涵盖ImageNet2K和Continual Google Landmarks V2数据集。③改进点在于首次系统分析计算约束对持续学习的影响。④实验超过1500 GPU小时，发现所有传统方法在计算受限下均无法超越简单基线。
2303.11165|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies that traditional continual learning ignores computational budget constraints, focusing only on storage. It introduces a large-scale benchmark evaluating sampling strategies, distillation losses, and partial fine-tuning under compute limits on ImageNet2K and Continual Google Landmarks V2. Results from 1500+ GPU-hours show all traditional methods fail to beat a minimal baseline.
2303.11165|v2.assessment: 该研究挑战了持续学习的核心假设，对实际部署有重要指导意义，实验充分。
2303.11165|v2.contribution: 揭示计算预算在持续学习中的关键作用，并提供大规模基准。
2303.11165|v2.innovation: 首次将计算约束纳入持续学习评估框架。
2303.11165|v2.result: 传统方法在计算受限下均不如简单基线。

2212.04842|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视频持续学习中的灾难性遗忘和参数效率问题。②提出了PIVOT方法，利用图像域预训练模型的提示机制，无需领域内预训练。③改进点在于首次在无视频预训练下有效使用提示进行持续学习，减少可训练参数。④在20任务ActivityNet上，PIVOT比现有最优方法提升27%。
2212.04842|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in video continual learning. PIVOT leverages prompting mechanisms from image pre-trained models without in-domain pre-training, reducing trainable parameters. It achieves a 27% improvement over state-of-the-art on 20-task ActivityNet.
2212.04842|v2.assessment: 方法创新且效果显著，为视频持续学习提供了高效解决方案。
2212.04842|v2.contribution: 提出PIVOT，首个无需视频预训练的提示式持续学习方法。
2212.04842|v2.innovation: 将图像域提示机制迁移至视频持续学习。

MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_cn: ①该论文针对持续学习中的腐败数据鲁棒性问题，即数据损坏导致模型性能下降。②提出了MetaMix方法，结合元学习和时间自适应数据变换。③改进点在于动态调整数据增强策略以适应任务变化。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_en: This paper addresses corruption robustness in continual learning. MetaMix integrates meta-learning with temporally self-adaptive data transformations. The innovation is dynamic augmentation adjustment. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.assessment: 腐败鲁棒性在真实场景中重要，但摘要缺失限制了评估。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.contribution: 提出MetaMix方法增强持续学习对数据腐败的鲁棒性。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.innovation: 时间自适应数据变换结合元学习。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti._arxiv_id: MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Continual Learning with Temporally Self-Adaptive Data Transformation.

VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉问答（VQA）中的持续学习问题，提出新设置VQACL。②定义了VQA持续学习场景，可能涉及多模态任务序列。③改进点在于将持续学习扩展到VQA领域，填补空白。④由于摘要不完整，无法提供具体效果数据。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_en: This paper introduces VQACL, a novel continual learning setting for visual question answering. It defines a multi-modal task sequence scenario. The contribution is extending continual learning to VQA. Specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.assessment: VQA持续学习是新兴方向，但摘要不完整，需进一步了解方法细节。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.contribution: 提出VQACL设置，推动VQA领域的持续学习研究。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.innovation: 首次定义VQA持续学习任务。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.result: 效果未知，因摘要不完整。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering._arxiv_id: VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering Continual Learning Setting.

Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_cn: ①针对梯度投影持续学习中稳定性与可塑性难以平衡的问题。②提出将特征空间解耦为稳定子空间和可塑子空间，分别用于保留旧知识和学习新知识，并设计相应的梯度投影策略。③相比传统梯度投影方法，通过显式空间解耦避免了投影对可塑性的过度限制。④实验表明在多个持续学习基准上取得了更优的平均准确率，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_en: This paper addresses the stability-plasticity dilemma in gradient projection based continual learning by decoupling the feature space into stable and plastic subspaces. It proposes dedicated projection strategies for each subspace to preserve old knowledge while accommodating new tasks. Experiments on standard benchmarks show improved average accuracy, though specific numbers are not reported in the abstract.
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.assessment: 该工作从特征空间结构角度切入梯度投影方法，思路新颖，对持续学习理论有贡献，但实验细节不足，影响力有限。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.contribution: 提出稳定性/可塑性特征空间解耦的梯度投影持续学习框架。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.innovation: 显式解耦特征空间并分别施加梯度约束，平衡旧知识保留与新知识学习。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.result: 在多个基准上平均准确率优于现有梯度投影方法。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual._arxiv_id: Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual Learning: Stability/Plasticity Feature Space Decoupling.

Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_cn: ①针对任务增量学习中学习新任务与记忆旧任务之间的冲突问题。②提出一个双层记忆框架，上层负责知识投影以约束参数更新，下层管理记忆样本的重放，实现学习与记忆的解耦。③相比单一重放或正则化方法，通过双层优化更精细地控制参数空间。④实验在多个任务增量基准上验证了有效性，但摘要未给出具体数据。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_en: This work tackles the conflict between learning new tasks and remembering old ones in task-incremental learning. It introduces a bilevel memory framework where an upper level projects knowledge to constrain parameter updates and a lower level manages exemplar replay, decoupling learning from remembering. Experiments on several benchmarks confirm effectiveness, though no specific metrics are listed.
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.assessment: 双层记忆框架设计合理，将知识投影与重放结合，对增量学习有实践价值，但创新程度一般。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.contribution: 提出双层记忆框架，通过知识投影与重放解耦学习与记忆过程。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.innovation: 利用双层优化结构同时约束参数更新和记忆管理。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.result: 在任务增量学习基准上取得优于对比方法的性能。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B._arxiv_id: Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a Bilevel Memory Framework with Knowledge Projection for Task-Incremental Learning.

Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_cn: ①针对基于样本回放的类增量学习中，批量归一化（BN）统计量因新旧类别样本不平衡而严重偏移的问题。②提出重新平衡BN统计量的方法，在训练和推理阶段分别调整BN的均值和方差，以适配混合样本分布。③相比直接使用标准BN或简单修正，该方法从统计量层面缓解了类别不平衡带来的偏差。④实验在CIFAR-100和ImageNet等数据集上显著提升了类增量准确率，具体提升幅度未在摘要中给出。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_en: This paper identifies that batch normalization statistics become severely biased due to class imbalance in exemplar-based class-incremental learning. It proposes rebalancing BN statistics during both training and inference to correct mean and variance shifts. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet show notable accuracy improvements over standard BN approaches.
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.assessment: 针对BN在增量学习中的实际痛点提出有效修正，实用性强，实验充分，值得关注。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.contribution: 提出重新平衡批量归一化统计量的方法，解决类增量学习中的类别不平衡问题。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.innovation: 在训练和推理阶段分别调整BN统计量以适配混合样本分布。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上显著提升类增量准确率。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem._arxiv_id: Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exemplar-Based Class-Incremental Learning.

DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中旧任务知识遗忘和新任务知识获取的平衡问题。②提出一种基于Transformer的多样知识迁移框架，通过可学习的知识迁移模块在不同任务间传递特征级和关系级知识。③相比传统知识蒸馏方法，该框架支持更丰富的知识形式，并自适应调整迁移强度。④实验在多个类增量基准上取得较好性能，但摘要未提供具体数值。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between forgetting old tasks and learning new ones in class-incremental learning. It proposes a Transformer-based diverse knowledge transfer framework that transfers feature-level and relation-level knowledge across tasks via learnable modules. Experiments on several benchmarks show competitive performance, though specific numbers are absent.
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.assessment: 将Transformer用于知识迁移，思路有一定新意，但实验细节不足，影响力中等。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的多样知识迁移框架用于类增量学习。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.innovation: 同时迁移特征级和关系级知识，并自适应调整迁移强度。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.result: 在多个类增量基准上取得较好性能。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor._arxiv_id: DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer for Class Incremental Learning.

Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中网络容量固定导致新类别学习受限的问题。②提出密集网络扩展方法，在需要时动态增加网络宽度和深度，并通过密集连接保留旧知识。③相比固定架构或简单扩展，该方法在扩展时利用密集连接促进新旧特征融合，减少遗忘。④实验在CIFAR-100和ImageNet等数据集上显著优于固定容量方法，具体准确率提升未在摘要中给出。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of fixed network capacity in class-incremental learning by proposing dense network expansion that dynamically grows width and depth. Dense connections between old and new layers help preserve prior knowledge and integrate new features. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet demonstrate clear improvements over fixed-capacity baselines.
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.assessment: 动态扩展网络结构是增量学习的有效方向，方法设计扎实，实验充分，具有较高参考价值。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.contribution: 提出密集网络扩展策略，动态增加容量并利用密集连接缓解遗忘。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.innovation: 通过密集连接融合新旧层特征，实现高效网络扩展。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上显著优于固定容量方法。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm._arxiv_id: Dense Network Expansion for Class Incremental Learning.

ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_cn: ①针对视频-语言连续学习缺乏统一基准的问题。②提出了ViLCo-Bench基准，包含视频语言连续学习任务的数据集和评估协议。③相比现有图像-语言连续学习基准，扩展到了视频模态，更贴近实际应用。④提供了标准化的评估框架，但摘要中未给出具体性能数据。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for video-language continual learning. It introduces ViLCo-Bench, a benchmark with datasets and evaluation protocols for video-language continual learning tasks. Compared to existing image-language benchmarks, it extends to video modality, better reflecting real-world applications. It provides a standardized evaluation framework, though no specific performance numbers are reported in the abstract.
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.assessment: 该基准填补了视频语言连续学习领域的空白，对多模态连续学习研究有参考价值。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.contribution: 提出了首个视频语言连续学习基准ViLCo-Bench。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.innovation: 将连续学习基准从图像扩展到视频模态。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.result: 提供了标准化评估框架，具体效果待验证。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le._arxiv_id: ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual learning Benchmark.

Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言模型在连续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出了基于Mixture-of-Experts适配器的方法，通过动态分配专家网络来适应新任务。③相比现有适配器方法，MoE结构增强了模型容量和任务特异性。④摘要中未给出具体数据，但方法在理论上能提升连续学习性能。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in vision-language models during continual learning. It proposes a Mixture-of-Experts adapter approach that dynamically allocates expert networks for new tasks. Compared to existing adapter methods, the MoE structure enhances model capacity and task specificity. No specific results are provided in the abstract, but the method theoretically improves continual learning performance.
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.assessment: MoE适配器为VLM连续学习提供了新思路，具有较强实用性。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.contribution: 提出MoE适配器用于增强VLM连续学习能力。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.innovation: 将MoE机制引入适配器以提升任务适应性。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.result: 理论上提升性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。

Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中运动预测模型在连续学习场景下的性能退化问题。②提出了基于元表示学习和最优记忆缓冲保留策略的方法，以平衡新知识与旧知识。③相比传统连续学习方法，元表示学习增强了跨任务泛化，记忆缓冲策略优化了样本保留。④摘要中未给出具体数据，但方法针对自动驾驶运动预测定制。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of motion prediction models in autonomous driving under continual learning. It proposes a method combining meta-representation learning and an optimal memory buffer retention strategy to balance new and old knowledge. Compared to traditional continual learning methods, meta-representation learning improves cross-task generalization, and the buffer strategy optimizes sample retention. No specific results are given in the abstract, but the method is tailored for autonomous driving motion prediction.
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.assessment: 针对自动驾驶运动预测的连续学习研究具有高应用价值，方法设计合理。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.contribution: 提出元表示学习与记忆缓冲策略用于运动预测连续学习。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.innovation: 结合元学习与最优缓冲保留以应对自动驾驶场景。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.result: 具体效果未在摘要中报告。

Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_cn: ①针对在线连续学习中表示学习不充分导致遗忘的问题。②提出了等角表示学习方法，通过约束特征空间的角度分布来增强表示稳定性。③相比现有方法，等角约束促进了类别可分性和旧知识保留。④摘要中未给出具体数据，但理论上能提升在线学习性能。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient representation learning causing forgetting in online continual learning. It proposes equi-angular representation learning that constrains angular distribution in feature space to enhance stability. Compared to existing methods, equi-angular constraints improve class separability and old knowledge retention. No specific results are provided, but it theoretically boosts online learning performance.
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.assessment: 等角表示方法在理论上具有创新性，但缺乏实验数据支撑。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.contribution: 提出等角表示学习用于在线连续学习。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.innovation: 利用角度约束优化特征空间分布。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.result: 理论有效，具体效果未报告。

Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_cn: ①针对在线连续学习中模型可塑性不足的问题。②提出了基于协作学习的方法，通过多个模型间的知识共享来提升可塑性。③相比单一模型方法，协作学习增强了适应新任务的能力。④摘要中未给出具体数据，但方法在概念上可行。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient plasticity in online continual learning. Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.contribution: 提出协作学习提升在线连续学习可塑性。

BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_cn: ①针对连续学习系统面临的安全漏洞，即恶意攻击者可诱导模型遗忘特定知识。②提出了BrainWash攻击方法，通过精心设计的毒化数据使模型在连续学习过程中遗忘目标类别。③相比现有攻击研究，首次聚焦于连续学习的遗忘攻击，揭示了安全风险。④摘要中未给出具体数据，但攻击方法具有明确威胁模型。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_en: This paper addresses security vulnerabilities in continual learning systems, where attackers can induce forgetting of specific knowledge. It proposes BrainWash, a poisoning attack that causes models to forget target classes during continual learning. Compared to existing attack research, it is the first to focus on forgetting attacks in continual learning, revealing security risks. No specific results are given, but the threat model is clear.
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.assessment: 该研究揭示了连续学习的安全隐患，对自动驾驶等安全关键领域有警示意义。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.contribution: 提出首个针对连续学习的遗忘攻击方法BrainWash。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.innovation: 将攻击目标从错误分类转向知识遗忘。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.result: 展示了攻击可行性，具体数据未报告。

Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_cn: ①针对无样本回放的持续学习（CFCL）中提示方法缺乏一致性、易受任务间干扰的问题。②提出一致性提示方法，通过约束提示在训练和推理时的分布一致性，减少任务混淆。③相比现有提示池方法，引入显式一致性正则化，无需存储旧样本。④在多个基准上验证，但摘要未提供具体数据，效果待查。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_en: Addresses inconsistency in prompt-based rehearsal-free continual learning. Proposes consistent prompting to align train/inference prompt distributions, reducing task interference. Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.result: 在基准上验证有效性，但未给出量化结果。

Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.contribution: 提出利用新数据复活旧类的方法。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.innovation: 动态更新旧类原型而非冻结。

ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.innovation: 提示调优与分割任务结合。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.result: 在基准上达到SOTA，具体数值待查。

InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_en: Addresses interference in LoRA-based continual learning. InfLoRA designs interference-free low-rank updates to preserve old knowledge. Improves over standard LoRA via subspace isolation; achieves higher accuracy on benchmarks, details in paper.

InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.innovation: 低秩子空间正交化设计。

Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的稳定性-可塑性困境，提出结合快速与慢速思考的交互式框架。②方法模拟人类认知的双系统，通过快速系统处理新任务、慢速系统巩固旧知识，并设计交互机制平衡两者。③相比传统单一模型，该框架显式建模不同时间尺度的学习过程，提升知识迁移与保留。④摘要未提供具体数据，但理论上可提升持续学习性能。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_en: This paper addresses the stability-plasticity dilemma in continual learning by proposing an interactive framework combining fast and slow thinking. It mimics dual-system cognition, using a fast system for new tasks and a slow system for consolidating old knowledge, with an interaction mechanism to balance them. Compared to traditional single-model approaches, it explicitly models learning at different timescales, potentially improving knowledge transfer and retention.

Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.contribution: 提出交互式快慢思考框架用于持续学习。

Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning with pre-trained models by proposing convolutional prompting, which embeds learnable convolutional kernels as prompts into Transformers and integrates language models for better generalization. Compared to existing prompt methods, convolutional prompts capture local spatial features, making them more suitable for vision tasks. It achieves significant improvements over state-of-the-art on multiple benchmarks.

Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_en: This paper addresses the dual challenges of data privacy and task continuity in federated continual learning by proposing a traceable framework that records model update trajectories and uses meta-information for knowledge transfer across tasks. Compared to traditional federated learning, it handles non-IID data and mitigates forgetting. The abstract emphasizes traceability for transparency and robustness without specific performance numbers.

2505.10649|v2.summary_cn: 针对全切片图像分析中传统多实例学习模型无法适应动态数据集、需要大量重训练的问题，本文分析了注意力多实例学习模型在持续学习场景下的遗忘机制，发现遗忘主要集中在注意力层。为此，提出了注意力知识蒸馏和伪袋记忆池两个组件，前者通过保留注意力层知识缓解灾难性遗忘，后者通过选择性存储最具信息量的补丁减少内存占用。实验表明，该方法在多个全切片图像数据集上显著提升了准确率和内存效率。
2505.10649|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that conventional multiple instance learning models for whole slide image analysis lack adaptability to evolving datasets. By analyzing attention-based MIL models, they find forgetting is concentrated in attention layers and propose Attention Knowledge Distillation and Pseudo-Bag Memory Pool to mitigate it. Experiments show significant improvements in accuracy and memory efficiency on diverse WSI datasets.
2505.10649|v2.assessment: 该论文将持续学习引入医学图像分析领域，针对特定模型结构提出针对性解决方案，对相关应用有参考价值，但领域相关性较低。
2505.10649|v2.contribution: 提出了针对注意力多实例学习的持续学习改进方法，包括注意力知识蒸馏和伪袋记忆池。
2505.10649|v2.innovation: 首次分析并利用注意力层遗忘特性设计持续学习策略。
2505.10649|v2.result: 在多个全切片图像数据集上显著提升准确率和内存效率。

2403.18886|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于预训练模型的持续学习方法因固定模块集导致学习能力受限、周期性添加任务特定模块导致模型线性增长和知识复用受损的问题，提出了SEMA方法。SEMA通过检测不同表示层上的显著分布偏移，自动决定重用或添加适配器模块，以增强稳定性-可塑性平衡。设计了由功能适配器和表示描述符组成的模块化适配器，实验表明该方法在多个持续学习基准上优于现有方法。
2403.18886|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited learning ability and linear model growth in pre-trained model-based continual learning. 2503.18371|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，受人类遗忘曲线理论启发。②提出view-batch模型，通过调整学习计划优化重训练同一批样本的回忆间隔，并设计了两种方法：保证最优回忆间隔的回放方法和自监督学习方法。③相比已有回放方法，创新性地将认知科学理论引入学习调度，强调“充分休息”以增强记忆保持。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果描述模糊，缺乏定量验证。
2503.18371|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by drawing inspiration from Ebbinghaus' forgetting curve theory. It proposes a view-batch model that adjusts learning schedules to optimize recall intervals between retraining the same samples, along with a replay method and a self-supervised approach. The innovation lies in applying cognitive science principles to learning scheduling, but the abstract lacks concrete experimental results, limiting its credibility.
2503.18371|v2.assessment: 理论新颖但实验验证不足，摘要信息量低，对持续学习领域贡献有限。
2503.18371|v2.contribution: 提出基于遗忘曲线理论的view-batch模型以优化持续学习中的回忆间隔。
2503.18371|v2.innovation: 将人类记忆遗忘曲线理论引入神经网络持续学习调度。
2503.18371|v2.result: 未提供具体数据，效果未经验证。

2503.18985|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无样本持续学习（EFCL）中特征漂移导致的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出漂移抵抗空间（DRS）概念，并设计参数高效微调方法LoRA减法（LoRA-），通过从预训练权重中减去旧任务的LoRA权重来建立DRS，无需存储旧样本。③相比依赖静态特征或过时统计的现有方法，LoRA-能动态适应特征空间演化，提升稳定性与效率。④摘要未给出具体数值，但强调在稳定性、效率和实现简便性上的优势。
2503.18985|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting caused by feature drift in exemplar-free continual learning (EFCL). It introduces a Drift-Resistant Space (DRS) and a novel parameter-efficient fine-tuning method, LoRA Subtraction (LoRA-), which subtracts old-task LoRA weights from pre-trained weights to establish DRS without storing previous samples. Unlike methods relying on static features, LoRA- adapts to dynamic feature evolution, enhancing stability and efficiency, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
2503.18985|v2.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，针对EFCL痛点有明确创新，但缺乏实验数据支撑，需看全文验证。
2503.18985|v2.contribution: 提出LoRA-减法方法构建漂移抵抗空间，解决无样本持续学习中的特征漂移问题。
2503.18985|v2.innovation: 通过LoRA权重减法动态构建DRS，避免存储旧任务样本。
2503.18985|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据，声称提升稳定性与效率。

2412.18177|v2.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习（OCL）中模型适应性不足，难以从单次数据流中学习泛化特征的问题。②提出即插即用模块S6MOD，在骨干网络后添加分支，利用选择性状态空间模型（SSM）和混合离散化方法自适应调整参数，并设计类条件路由算法和对比离散化损失进行优化。③相比依赖回放和正则化的现有方法，S6MOD直接提升模型适应性，可集成到多数OCL方法中。④实验表明S6MOD显著增强模型适应性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2412.18177|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adaptability of models in online continual learning (OCL), which hinders learning generalizable features from single-pass data streams. It proposes a plug-and-play module, S6MOD, that adds a branch after the backbone, using a selective state space model with a mixture of discretization to adaptively adjust parameters, plus a class-conditional routing algorithm and contrastive loss. S6MOD can be integrated into existing methods, and experiments show improved adaptability, though specific metrics are absent.
2412.18177|v2.assessment: 模块化设计具有实用价值，但创新性一般，效果数据不充分。
2412.18177|v2.contribution: 提出S6MOD即插即用模块，增强OCL模型的适应性。
2412.18177|v2.innovation: 将状态空间模型与混合离散化结合用于在线持续学习。
2412.18177|v2.result: 实验显示适应性显著提升，但无具体数据。

2503.12053|v2.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习（OCL）在高频数据流中实时学习且内存受限的问题。②提出Ferret框架，采用细粒度流水线并行策略和迭代梯度补偿算法，实现低延迟处理，并通过自动模型分区和流水线规划适应不同内存预算。③相比现有OCL方法，Ferret在内存效率和适应性上显著提升，可集成多种算法。④在20个基准和5种OCL算法上，达到相同在线精度时内存开销降低高达3.7倍，并在不同内存预算下持续优于对比方法。
2503.12053|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles real-time learning in online continual learning (OCL) under high-frequency data streams and varying memory constraints. It introduces Ferret, a framework with fine-grained pipeline parallelism and iterative gradient compensation to minimize latency, plus automated model partitioning for memory adaptation. Across 20 benchmarks and 5 OCL algorithms, Ferret achieves up to 3.7x lower memory overhead for the same online accuracy and consistently outperforms baselines under diverse memory budgets.
2503.12053|v2.assessment: 工程性强，实验充分，对实际部署有重要价值，值得关注。
2503.12053|v2.contribution: 提出Ferret框架，实现内存约束下的高效在线持续学习。
2503.12053|v2.innovation: 结合流水线并行与梯度补偿，动态适应内存预算。
2503.12053|v2.result: 内存开销降低3.7倍，精度保持领先。

BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中参数空间干扰导致灾难性遗忘的问题。②提出BiLoRA方法，利用几乎正交的参数空间来减少任务间干扰。③摘要不完整，缺乏方法细节和实验数据。④无具体效果。
BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing BiLoRA, which uses almost-orthogonal parameter spaces to reduce interference between tasks. However, the abstract is incomplete, lacking methodological details and experimental results.
BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac.assessment: 摘要不完整，无法全面评估，但方向有一定潜力。
BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac.contribution: 提出BiLoRA方法，利用几乎正交参数空间缓解遗忘。
BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac.innovation: 将LoRA扩展至正交参数空间设计。
BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac._arxiv_id: BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spaces for Continual Learning.

Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.summary_cn: ①针对视频类增量学习（Video Class-Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘和时序信息利用不足的问题。②提出学习条件空间-时间提示分布（Conditional Space-Time Prompt Distributions），通过为每个任务生成动态提示，并结合空间和时间上下文来引导模型适应新类。③相比静态提示方法，该方法能捕捉视频中的时序动态，增强提示的适应性和判别力。④在多个视频增量基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and insufficient temporal exploitation in video class-incremental learning. It proposes learning conditional space-time prompt distributions to generate dynamic prompts that incorporate spatial and temporal contexts. Compared to static prompts, this enhances adaptability and discrimination. It achieves superior performance on multiple video incremental benchmarks, though specific numbers are not given.
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.assessment: 针对视频领域增量学习的独特挑战，引入时空提示分布，具有创新性，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证实验细节。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.contribution: 提出条件时空提示分布方法，用于视频类增量学习。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.innovation: 将提示学习扩展到时空维度，动态建模视频中的时序变化。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.result: 在视频增量基准上取得领先性能。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D._arxiv_id: Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt Distributions for Video Class-Incremental Learning.

Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.summary_cn: ①针对基于预训练模型的域增量学习（Domain-Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘问题。②提出双重巩固（Dual Consolidation）策略，结合参数级和表征级巩固，以保持预训练模型的知识并适应新域。③相比单一巩固方法，双重机制更全面地平衡稳定性和可塑性。④在多个域增量基准上验证了有效性，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in pre-trained model-based domain-incremental learning. It proposes a dual consolidation strategy that combines parameter-level and representation-level consolidation to preserve knowledge while adapting to new domains. This dual mechanism better balances stability and plasticity than single consolidation methods. It demonstrates effectiveness on multiple benchmarks, though specifics are omitted.
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.assessment: 针对域增量学习提出双重巩固框架，思路清晰，但摘要缺乏实验细节，创新性中等。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.contribution: 提出双重巩固方法，用于预训练模型下的域增量学习。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.innovation: 同时进行参数和表征层面的巩固，增强知识保持。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.result: 在域增量基准上表现良好。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model._arxiv_id: Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model-Based Domain-Incremental Learning.

2503.17677|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（CIL）中原型方法表征能力不足和特征重叠导致的类间混淆问题。②提出CREATE（Confusion-REduced AuTo-Encoder classifier），使用轻量级自编码器为每个类学习低维流形，并设计混淆感知的潜在空间分离损失，使样本在正确类上重建良好且远离其他类分布。③相比传统原型方法，增强了类分布的稳定性和表征能力，显式缓解特征重叠。④实验表明该方法在多个CIL基准上性能更强，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2503.17677|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses class-wise confusion in class-incremental learning caused by inadequate representation and feature overlap in prototype methods. It proposes CREATE, which employs a lightweight auto-encoder to learn compact manifolds per class and a confusion-aware separation loss to push samples away from other classes. This enhances representation stability and mitigates overlap. Experiments show stronger performance on CIL benchmarks, though numbers are not specified.
2503.17677|v2.assessment: 针对CIL中关键的特征重叠问题提出有效解决方案，方法设计合理，实验充分，具有较高参考价值。
2503.17677|v2.contribution: 提出CREATE方法，通过自编码器和分离损失减少类间混淆。
2503.17677|v2.innovation: 利用类专属流形和混淆感知损失增强原型表征。
2503.17677|v2.result: 在CIL基准上取得更强性能。

Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning）中预训练模型适配不足和模态校准缺失的问题。②提出训练无关的双层模态校准方法（Training-Free Bi-Level Modality Calibration），在无需额外训练的情况下，通过双层校准调整视觉和文本模态的特征分布。③相比需要微调的方法，该方法计算开销低且易于部署。④在少样本增量基准上验证了有效性，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient adaptation and modality calibration in few-shot class-incremental learning. It proposes a training-free bi-level modality calibration method that adjusts visual and textual feature distributions without extra training. This reduces computational cost compared to fine-tuning approaches. It shows effectiveness on few-shot benchmarks, though specifics are absent.
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.assessment: 提出免训练的模态校准方法，实用性强，但摘要信息有限，创新深度一般。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.contribution: 提出训练无关的双层模态校准，用于少样本类增量学习。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.innovation: 无需训练即可校准多模态特征，提升泛化。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.result: 在少样本增量基准上表现有效。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea._arxiv_id: Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning via Training-Free Bi-Level Modality Calibration.

2412.18219|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（CIL）中推理时间与精度权衡以及可扩展性问题。②提出ACMap（Adapter Merging with Centroid Prototype Mapping），将任务特定适配器合并为单一适配器，实现恒定推理时间，并通过质心原型映射保持高精度。③相比现有方法，ACMap在保持精度的同时显著降低推理开销，并采用早停策略提升可扩展性。④在五个基准数据集上，ACMap匹配最先进精度，推理时间与最快方法相当。
2412.18219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between inference time and accuracy in class-incremental learning. It proposes ACMap, which merges task-specific adapters into one to achieve constant inference time, while centroid prototype mapping maintains accuracy. This balances efficiency and performance better than existing methods. Experiments on five benchmarks show it matches state-of-the-art accuracy with inference time comparable to the fastest methods.
2412.18219|v2.assessment: 针对CIL中的效率问题提出优雅的适配器合并方案，实验充分，实用价值高。
2412.18219|v2.contribution: 提出ACMap框架，实现恒定推理时间且不牺牲精度。
2412.18219|v2.innovation: 通过适配器合并和质心映射统一任务表征。
2412.18219|v2.result: 在五个基准上匹配最先进精度，推理时间最快。

Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.summary_cn: ①针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习（CIL）中知识遗忘和利用不足的问题。②提出知识记忆与反刍机制（Knowledge Memorization and Rumination），通过记忆旧知识并在新任务学习时反复回顾，以增强知识保持和迁移。③相比简单回放或正则化方法，该机制更显式地模拟人类认知过程。④在CIL基准上验证了有效性，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge forgetting and underutilization in pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning. It proposes a memorization and rumination mechanism that stores old knowledge and revisits it during new task learning. This enhances retention and transfer compared to simple replay or regularization. It shows effectiveness on CIL benchmarks, though specifics are not given.
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.assessment: 提出知识反刍的认知启发方法，概念有趣，但摘要缺乏实验细节，创新性中等。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.contribution: 提出知识记忆与反刍机制，用于预训练模型下的CIL。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.innovation: 模拟认知反刍过程，动态回顾旧知识。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo._arxiv_id: Knowledge Memorization and Rumination for Pre-trained Model-based Class-Incremental Learning.

2503.22163|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中模型置信度校准被忽视的问题，提出T-CIL方法，利用记忆中的对抗扰动样本来进行温度缩放，无需旧任务验证集。通过基于特征距离调整扰动方向，使新任务计算的扰动幅度适用于旧任务，解决了旧任务数据有限时校准困难的问题。实验表明该方法在保持准确率的同时有效提升了校准性能。
2503.22163|v2.summary_en: Addressing the overlooked issue of confidence calibration in class-incremental learning, T-CIL proposes a temperature scaling method using adversarially perturbed exemplars from memory without requiring a validation set for old tasks. By adjusting perturbation direction based on feature distance, it makes the perturbation magnitude from new tasks applicable to old ones, improving calibration while maintaining accuracy.
2503.22163|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦于类增量学习中的校准问题，这是一个重要但研究较少的方面，方法具有创新性，但相关性较低。
2503.22163|v2.contribution: 提出无需旧任务验证集的温度缩放校准方法T-CIL。
2503.22163|v2.innovation: 利用对抗扰动和特征距离调整实现跨任务校准。
2503.22163|v2.result: 在类增量学习基准上提升了校准性能。

2502.20032|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中对类别到达顺序敏感的问题，通过理论分析证明在增量阶段分组低相似度类别可提升模型鲁棒性，提出图驱动动态相似度分组方法GDDSG，利用图着色算法动态划分类别组，每组训练独立子模型并构建元特征。实验表明该方法有效解决了顺序敏感性问题，并在准确率和抗遗忘性上达到最优。
2502.20032|v2.summary_en: Addressing the class order sensitivity in class incremental learning, GDDSG uses graph coloring to dynamically group classes with low similarity, training isolated sub-models per group. Theoretical analysis supports that this grouping improves robustness to order variations, and experiments show optimal accuracy and anti-forgetting performance.
2502.20032|v2.assessment: 该论文深入分析了类增量学习中的顺序敏感性问题，并提出有效的图驱动解决方案，但相关性较低。
2502.20032|v2.contribution: 提出图驱动动态相似度分组方法以解决类增量学习中的顺序敏感性问题。
2502.20032|v2.innovation: 利用图着色算法动态划分类别组。
2502.20032|v2.result: 在准确率和抗遗忘性上达到最优。

2506.15720|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本类增量学习中模型更新导致遗忘和过拟合的问题，提出三部分权重空间集成方法Tri-WE，在权重空间中对基础模型、前一模型和当前模型进行插值，特别是分类头部分，以协同维护知识。同时解决从先前模型提取通用表示的问题，实验表明该方法有效缓解了灾难性遗忘和过拟合。
2506.15720|v2.summary_en: For few-shot class incremental learning, Tri-WE interpolates base, previous, and current models in weight-space, especially for classification heads, to collaboratively maintain knowledge and address forgetting and overfitting. It also tackles challenges in distilling generalized representations, showing effectiveness in experiments.
2506.15720|v2.assessment: 该论文提出新颖的权重空间集成方法，对少样本类增量学习有贡献，但相关性较低。
2506.15720|v2.contribution: 提出三部分权重空间集成方法Tri-WE。
2506.15720|v2.innovation: 在权重空间插值多个模型以协同知识维护。
2506.15720|v2.result: 有效缓解了灾难性遗忘和过拟合。

2409.14983|v2.summary_cn: 针对无样本类增量学习中旧任务数据缺失加剧灾难性遗忘的问题，提出动态集成任务特定适配器框架DIA，包含任务特定适配器集成和补丁级模型对齐。通过补丁级适配器集成策略提升组合性，并利用补丁级蒸馏损失和特征重建方法保持特征一致性和决策边界。实验表明该方法在NECIL中有效缓解了遗忘。
2409.14983|v2.summary_en: For non-exemplar class incremental learning, DIA integrates task-specific adapters and uses patch-level model alignment with distillation and feature reconstruction to maintain consistency and decision boundaries. This addresses catastrophic forgetting without storing old exemplars, showing effectiveness in experiments.
2409.14983|v2.assessment: 该论文针对无样本类增量学习提出动态适配器集成方法，具有实用性，但相关性较低。
2409.14983|v2.contribution: 提出动态集成任务特定适配器框架DIA。
2409.14983|v2.innovation: 补丁级适配器集成和模型对齐机制。
2409.14983|v2.result: 在NECIL中有效缓解了灾难性遗忘。
